They also resist with Strength + Athletics; if you beat them, they are knocked prone.

Mana Cost: 2, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, add your Heritage dots to rolls to lift or carry. Carrying an ally costs no extra AP while moving.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: A straight line up to two zones Dice Pool: Strength + Melee or Martial Arts + Titan's Weight Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: Charge in a straight line past up to two enemies, ending in an empty zone. Roll once; each enemy you pass defends separately.

Mana Cost: 3, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Attuned Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, gain Armor equal to half your Heritage dots, rounded up.

Mana Cost: 4, upkeep 3 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Persistent Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Fortitude + Athletics + Titan's Weight Defense: Strength + Athletics Effect: Roll when cast. While maintained, enemies must beat your successes with Strength + Athletics to move into or through any zone adjacent to you, and allies in adjacent zones add 2 to their Damage Threshold against ranged attacks.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: One target in sight Dice Pool: Strength + Melee or Martial Arts + Titan's Weight Defense: Target's choice of defense; a thrown creature does not defend Effect: Throw a heavy object or a grappled creature at the target. The target and a thrown creature both take the damage of the hit.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant Type: Debuff Use: Combat Range: All adjacent zones Dice Pool: Strength + Melee or Martial Arts + Titan's Weight Defense: Dexterity + Athletics Effect: Every enemy in range resists with Dexterity + Athletics. Each one you beat is knocked prone. Those zones become Difficult Terrain for the rest of the scene.

Mana Cost: 5, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Attuned Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, attacks you make after moving at least one zone that turn add your Heritage dots to the damage roll.

Mana Cost: 6, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Attuned Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, you grow, and your melee attacks reach targets in adjacent zones.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Reaction Type: Defense Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: Once per turn, treat one hit against you as two damage thresholds lower: Aggravated becomes Bashing, and Lethal or Bashing deals nothing.

Mana Cost: 7 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: Any empty zone in sight Dice Pool: Strength + Melee or Martial Arts + Titan's Weight Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: Leap to the zone. Roll once; every target in a zone adjacent to where you land defends separately. The landing zone becomes Difficult Terrain.

Mana Cost: 7, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Attuned Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, add 3 to Strength and Fortitude for all rolls and thresholds.

From "Peoples of the Known World" by Liris Kant, Third Chair of Natural Philosophy, Monsera University The Dwarves live in the Blue Dragon Mountain Range, a cold, steep region with many natural hot springs. I have made two field visits. Their written records go back further than those of most peoples I have studied, and they lived in the range before those records began. The hot springs are the center of public life. Dwarves bathe, meet, trade, and negotiate in them. Several major political agreements in Dwarven history were settled in the springs. I attended two council sessions held this way, and both were calmer than similar sessions I have seen elsewhere. Steam power reached the kingdom before the crystal network did. When the network arrived, the Dwarves adopted it for long distance messages but kept steam for heating, industry, and rail. When I asked why, the answer was always the same: they built the steam systems themselves, and they prefer them. They know mana powered heating is more efficient. The choice is cultural, not technical, and their cities show it in gas lamps, steam trains, and exposed gearwork kept in careful repair. Children are raised in birth year cohorts. Every child born in the same year is cared for by trained caregivers whose profession is raising children. Parents stay involved, but the cohort is the child's main social group, and cohort bonds often last for life. Honesty is taught early. A child caught lying is usually punished with a hard tickling, and most adult Dwarves still cannot keep a straight face when they lie. A Dwarven child has no personal name until age ten. Before then they are called the child of their parents. At ten they choose a name and keep it for life, which can be two hundred years. The Dwarves I interviewed said ten is old enough to know something true about yourself and young enough to grow into a name. The title of Ore God goes to the most skilled maker in the kingdom. It cannot be inherited or bought. Other makers recognize it, and the holder keeps it only while they remain the best. I have met two Ore Gods. Both were working craftspeople first and public figures a distant second.

Average Lifespan: 200 years. Innate Attribute (choose 1, note Innate on sheet): Fortitude: For a character whose toughness and physical resilience define them. Wisdom: For a character whose quiet calculation and self reflection define them. Innate Flaw - Giggle Fibbers: A Dwarven child caught lying by a caregiver is usually punished with a harsh tickling. Even as adults, Dwarves find it hard to keep a straight face whenever they try to lie, which is where their straightforward, honest reputation comes from. Dwarves suffer a 1 to 3 die penalty on any roll to lie, depending on the severity of the lie, as set by the Storyteller. Attribute Flaw - Social: Social attributes cannot be your Affinity column. They can only be your Standard or Aversion column. Heritage Merit (choose 1, record in Merits, Flaws, and Backgrounds section): Dwarven Crafting: Grants a free specialty in Crafts reflecting the Dwarf's natural gift for making and repairing physical objects. Dwarven Constitution: Grants a free specialty in Endurance called Iron Gut, providing a bonus die against poison, toxins, and other ingested or inhaled hazards.

Dwarves say the mountain hums, and that a good smith can hear which note a stone wants to become. Earthsong reads stone and metal, blesses what the forge produces, and holds the ground steady beneath a Dwarf's feet. Primary: Wisdom + Crafts + Earthsong Secondary: Fortitude + Endurance + Earthsong Extra mana: Attack or damage. 1 die per mana, up to your Earthsong dots or Max Mana Per Turn, whichever comes first.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Utility Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Touch Dice Pool: Wisdom + Crafts + Earthsong Defense: None Effect: Touch stone or worked metal. On a success you learn its age, origin, and flaws. Each success also adds a bonus die to your next Crafts roll to repair or appraise it.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Reaction Type: Defense Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Fortitude + Endurance + Earthsong Defense: None Effect: When something would knock you prone or force you out of your zone, resist with this dice pool instead of your normal roll.

Mana Cost: 2, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: One weapon or armor piece you touch Dice Pool: Wisdom + Crafts + Earthsong Defense: None Effect: While attuned, the item's rating is 1 higher. Only one item can carry Forge Blessing at a time.

Mana Cost: 2, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Utility, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Wisdom + Crafts + Earthsong Defense: None Effect: While attuned and standing on the ground, add your Heritage dots to Awareness rolls to detect anything moving on the ground within a number of zones equal to your Earthsong dots, including hidden or invisible creatures.

Mana Cost: 3, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Fortitude + Endurance + Earthsong Defense: None Effect: While attuned, add half your Heritage dots, rounded up, to your BDT.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: Melee Dice Pool: Wisdom + Crafts + Earthsong Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: Make a weapon or unarmed attack with this dice pool. It ignores Armor equal to your Heritage dots. Against objects and constructs, the damage value is doubled.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Reaction Type: Defense Use: Combat Range: Self or one ally in an adjacent zone Dice Pool: Fortitude + Endurance + Earthsong Defense: None Effect: When the target would be moved, knocked prone, or Rooted, they resist with your dice pool instead of their own.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Debuff Use: Combat Range: All adjacent zones Dice Pool: Wisdom + Crafts + Earthsong Defense: Dexterity + Athletics Effect: Stomp. Every enemy in range resists with Dexterity + Athletics. Each one you beat is knocked prone.

Mana Cost: 5, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self and allies in adjacent zones Dice Pool: Wisdom + Crafts + Earthsong Defense: None Effect: While attuned, weapons and armor carried by you and allies in adjacent zones count as 1 rating higher.

Mana Cost: 5, upkeep 4 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Persistent Use: Combat Range: One edge of a zone in sight Dice Pool: Wisdom + Crafts + Earthsong Defense: An attack on the wall must roll more successes than your casting roll Effect: Raise a stone wall. It blocks movement and line of sight. An attack against the wall breaks it only if the attacker rolls more successes than you did when casting.

Mana Cost: 6, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Attuned Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Fortitude + Endurance + Earthsong Defense: None Effect: While attuned, Lethal damage you take becomes Bashing, and Aggravated damage becomes Lethal.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: Straight line across the battlefield Dice Pool: Wisdom + Crafts + Earthsong Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: Crack the ground in a line from you. Roll once; each target in the line defends separately. Each target hit is knocked prone, and their zone becomes Difficult Terrain.

Mana Cost: 7 Speed: Downtime Type: Utility Use: Outside combat only Range: Touch Dice Pool: Wisdom + Crafts + Earthsong Defense: None Effect: Over a single scene, with the materials at hand, forge or reforge one item of any rating up to 7.

Mana Cost: 7, upkeep 6 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Utility, Persistent Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Up to 6 connected zones in sight Dice Pool: Wisdom + Crafts + Earthsong Defense: None Effect: Reshape the ground: raise walls, open pits, or seal passages. During each Upkeep Phase while maintained, you may reshape one of those zones again.

From "Peoples of the Known World" by Liris Kant, Third Chair of Natural Philosophy, Monsera University The Elves of the Great Forest are the oldest continuous civilization in Terrana. I have visited four times. For most of a generation, every Elven child of university age has crossed the Ringus Sea to study at Monsera University and then returned home. What they brought back was added to Elven culture. It did not replace it. The Elves did not clear the forest to build their city. The city is built into the forest. They have never treated nature and scholarship as opposites. Elves live about a thousand years. A single Elf may see several periods of Hyuman history begin and end. They are not slow. They are deliberate, and they make decisions on a longer timescale than most peoples.

Average Lifespan: 1000 years. Innate Attribute (choose 1, note Innate on sheet): Intelligence: For a character focused on magical knowledge and casting depth. Fortitude: For a character focused on raw mana capacity and sustained channeling. Innate Flaw - Insular Grace: The Elf suffers a 1 die penalty on social rolls with non-Elf heritages. When dealing with other Elves they receive a 1 die bonus instead. Attribute Flaw - Social: Social attributes cannot be your Affinity column. They can only be your Standard or Aversion column. Heritage Merit (choose 1, record in Merits, Flaws, and Backgrounds section): Elven Compass: Grants a free specialty in Survival called Elven Compass, providing a bonus die on any Survival roll involving navigation and orientation. Mana Touched: Grants one additional starting dot in Mana beyond the standard starting value of 1.

The Elves hear the Great Forest the way other peoples hear weather. Verdant Communion is that listening turned into action: speaking with plants and the minor spirits that live in them, reading the air, and asking the living world to move. Primary: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Secondary: Intelligence + Attunement + Verdant Communion Extra mana: Attack or damage. 1 die per mana, up to your Verdant Communion dots or Max Mana Per Turn, whichever comes first.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Downtime Type: Utility Use: Outside combat only Range: Touch Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Defense: None Effect: Hold a slow conversation with one plant or the minor spirit living in it. Plants think slowly; even asking for directions can take the better part of an hour. The plant shares what it has sensed over the last few days through sound, vibration, warmth, and touch, such as who passed and which way they went. It cannot see.

Mana Cost: 1, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant Type: Enhancement, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Defense: None Effect: While attuned, add your Heritage dots to Awareness rolls to notice movement within a number of zones equal to your Verdant Communion dots.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Debuff Use: Combat Range: One target in an adjacent zone Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Defense: Dexterity + Athletics Effect: The target resists with Dexterity + Athletics. If you roll more successes, they gain the Rooted condition until the end of their next turn.

Mana Cost: 2, upkeep 1 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Persistent Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self and allies in adjacent zones Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Defense: Perception + Awareness Effect: Roll when cast. While maintained and in natural terrain, your casting roll becomes the Stealth roll for you and every ally in an adjacent zone. They do not roll Stealth themselves; anyone searching for them must beat your successes with Perception + Awareness.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Downtime Type: Utility Use: Outside combat only Range: The surrounding area, up to about a mile Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Defense: None Effect: Spend a scene in communion with the land. Ask one question per success about the area, such as hidden dangers, water, paths, or recent travelers. The Storyteller answers each truthfully in a few words.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Reaction Type: Defense Use: Combat Range: Self or one ally in an adjacent zone Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Defense: None Effect: When the target is attacked from range, plants rise to intercept. Roll your dice pool. Each success reduces the attacker's successes by 1.

Mana Cost: 4, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Movement, Attuned Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Defense: None Effect: While attuned, natural Difficult Terrain costs you no extra AP. Allies who move through the same zones on the same turn as you ignore that Difficult Terrain as well.

Mana Cost: 4, upkeep 3 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Attack, Persistent Use: Combat Range: One zone in sight Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Defense: Fortitude + Endurance, which reduces the damage value Effect: Roll when cast. Successes plus mana spent set the damage value. The zone becomes thorned Difficult Terrain. Anyone who enters or begins their turn there rolls Fortitude + Endurance; their successes reduce the damage value, and the rest is compared against their damage thresholds.

Mana Cost: 5, upkeep 4 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Conjuration, Persistent Use: Combat Range: One tree or large plant in an adjacent zone Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Defense: Target's choice of defense against its attacks; Dexterity + Athletics against its Rootbind Effect: The plant becomes a conjuration that cannot leave its zone. During each Upkeep Phase it may attack one enemy in a zone adjacent to it using your dice pool, or cast Rootbind on one at no extra mana.

Mana Cost: 5, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Utility, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Intelligence + Attunement + Verdant Communion Defense: None Effect: While attuned, you see mana flowing. When a spell is cast within a number of zones equal to your Verdant Communion dots, roll your dice pool; on a success you learn its school and rank.

Mana Cost: 6, upkeep 5 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Debuff, Persistent Use: Combat Range: Up to 3 connected zones in sight Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Defense: Dexterity + Athletics Effect: The zones become living forest. Allies in them add a bonus die to Dodge rolls. During each Upkeep Phase, each enemy in them resists with Dexterity + Athletics against your casting successes or gains the Rooted condition.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Reaction Type: Movement Use: Combat Range: One ally in sight Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Verdant Communion Defense: None Effect: When the ally is targeted by an attack, the wind moves them one zone before it resolves. The attacker rolls against them with -2 dice.

It answers one question truthfully and in full, or performs one feat the Storyteller judges within the power of a forest, such as raising a wall of trees across six zones.

Goblins, Mimics, Knockers, Gnomes, Boggles, and similar. Small, clever, and constitutionally incapable of leaving well enough alone. From Liris Kant's entry on the monster peoples Gremlinesque is my umbrella term for the goblins, gnomes, mimics, knockers, and other small, clever peoples. Most share a strong urge to understand machines by taking them apart. They have contributed much to Monsera's technology, though official histories rarely credit them, since they tend to work in basements and workshops. The Dwarves privately respect the knockers' work on underground infrastructure and publicly decline to comment.

Average Lifespan: 100 to 200 years depending on type. Innate Attribute (choose 1, note Innate on sheet): Intelligence: For a character whose sharp mind and technical aptitude define them. Dexterity: For a character whose quick hands and nimble movement define them. Innate Flaw - Mischief Prone: Gremlinesque monsters suffer a penalty die on Diplomacy rolls. Their chaotic and impulsive nature makes formal negotiation difficult. Attribute Flaw - Physical: Physical attributes cannot be your Affinity column. They can only be your Standard or Aversion column. Heritage Merit (choose 1, record in Merits, Flaws, and Backgrounds section): Tinker: Grants a free specialty in either Crafts or Implements reflecting their innate knack for gadgets and mechanisms. Scurry: Grants a free specialty in Acrobatics reflecting their ability to move through cluttered, tight, and chaotic environments at speed.

Gremlinesque peoples cannot leave a device alone, and their magic agrees with them. Tinker's Spark wakes machines, breaks them, overcharges them, and turns a pocket full of scrap into something that explodes at the right moment. Primary: Intelligence + Crafts + Tinker's Spark Secondary: Dexterity + Implements + Tinker's Spark Extra mana: Attack only. 1 die per mana, up to your Tinker's Spark dots or Max Mana Per Turn, whichever comes first.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Utility Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Touch Dice Pool: Intelligence + Crafts + Tinker's Spark Defense: Dice equal to the device's rating Effect: Power on, switch off, or open a small device or simple lock. The device resists with dice equal to its rating; you need more successes.

Mana Cost: 1, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, add your Heritage dots to rolls to understand, take apart, or find the flaw in a device.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Utility Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Dexterity + Implements + Tinker's Spark Defense: None Effect: Build a one-use gadget from scrap: a smoke puff, noisemaker, flash, or trip line. It must be used before the end of the scene, and its effect resolves with this roll's successes.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Debuff Use: Combat Range: One device, weapon, or implement in sight Dice Pool: Intelligence + Crafts + Tinker's Spark Defense: Intelligence + Crafts Effect: The item's user resists with Intelligence + Crafts. If you beat them, they lose dice equal to your extra successes on their next roll with that item.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Enhancement Use: Combat Range: One ally's weapon or implement in an adjacent zone Dice Pool: Intelligence + Crafts + Tinker's Spark Defense: None Effect: The ally adds your successes, up to your Heritage dots, as bonus dice on their next roll with the item. The item then suffers -1 die for the rest of the scene.

Mana Cost: 3, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Utility, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Dexterity + Implements + Tinker's Spark Defense: Perception + Awareness Effect: Roll when you attune. While attuned you look like an object of your size. Spotting you requires beating your successes with Perception + Awareness.

Mana Cost: 4, upkeep 3 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Conjuration, Persistent Use: Combat Range: One device or small construct in an adjacent zone Dice Pool: Dexterity + Implements + Tinker's Spark Defense: Target's choice of defense against its attacks Effect: The device becomes a conjuration. During each Upkeep Phase it may move one zone, or attack one enemy in a zone adjacent to it using your dice pool.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Debuff Use: Combat Range: All adjacent zones Dice Pool: Intelligence + Crafts + Tinker's Spark Defense: None for devices; constructs and conjurations roll their maker's dice pool Effect: Crystal network devices and implements in range stop working until the end of your next turn. Constructs and conjurations resist with their maker's dice pool.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Reaction Type: Utility Use: Combat and outside combat Range: One item, construct, or conjuration in sight Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: When an ally's item, construct, or conjuration would break, be destroyed, or end from damage, roll your dice pool. On a success it is repaired at once and the hit that caused it has no effect.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: One zone in sight Dice Pool: Dexterity + Implements + Tinker's Spark Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: Throw a gadget at the zone. It bursts across that zone and every zone adjacent to it. Roll once; each target in those zones defends separately.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Downtime Type: Utility Use: Outside combat only Range: Touch Dice Pool: Intelligence + Crafts + Tinker's Spark Defense: None Effect: Over a session of work, build one permanent gadget with a rating up to your Heritage dots.

Mana Cost: 7, upkeep 6 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Conjuration, Persistent Use: Combat Range: An adjacent zone Dice Pool: Intelligence + Crafts + Tinker's Spark Defense: Target's choice of defense against its attacks Effect: Assemble a combat construct as a conjuration. During each Upkeep Phase it attacks every enemy in zones adjacent to it using your dice pool; each defends separately.

Mana Cost: 7 Speed: Instant Type: Utility Use: Combat and outside combat Range: One constructed object or construct in sight Dice Pool: Intelligence + Crafts + Tinker's Spark Defense: Dice equal to the object's rating, or a construct's maker's dice pool Effect: The object resists with dice equal to its rating, or a construct with its maker's dice pool. If you beat it, it falls apart into its component parts.

From "Peoples of the Known World" by Liris Kant, Third Chair of Natural Philosophy, Monsera University Outsiders often describe the Halflings as quaint. They are not. Their society is the result of deliberate decisions about how to live well, and it works. Halfling homes are built into hillsides, with round doors and grass roofs. Inside, most have a fast crystal relay connection and a full display setup alongside the hearth. The household I stayed with watched colosseum matches on a display Crystal across the room from a wood fire. By law, every Halfling contributes two hours of community work each day before using personal devices. Shared work is spread evenly, no one carries an unfair load, and the rest of the day belongs to the individual. The law applies to everyone, but the form of contribution is fitted to the person. Those who cannot lift may teach. Those who cannot walk may advise. Those with fluctuating health contribute when they are able, and the community covers the difference. Leisure is taken seriously. Halflings invented several card games now played across Terrana, usually for rising stakes. They run one of the most active CCN content communities in the world for their population size. They are also the largest growers and distributors of pipe weed in Terrana. Some family strains carry formal recognition from the Merchants Guild, and vintage harvests can sell for more than a modest house in the Asura Kingdom. My host, a retired cartographer named Aldous, offered me a pipe on my first evening. My notes from the next morning are unusually philosophical. Halflings are very good at being underestimated, and they know it. Their size and friendliness lower people's guard in negotiation. In one afternoon I watched it work three times.

Average Lifespan: 200 years. Innate Attribute (choose 1, note Innate on sheet): Charisma: For a character whose warmth and natural likability define them. Dexterity: For a character whose quickness and nimble nature define them. Innate Flaw - Underestimated: Halflings suffer a 1 die penalty on Expression rolls. People across most heritages do not instinctively take them seriously regardless of what they are saying or how they say it. Attribute Flaw - Physical: Physical attributes cannot be your Affinity column. They can only be your Standard or Aversion column. Heritage Merit (choose 1, record in Merits, Flaws, and Backgrounds section): A Lil Luck: Once per session you may add your dots in this merit to any single roll. Can be declared before or after the initial roll, similar to a Willpower spend. Disarming Charm: Grants a free specialty in Subterfuge called Disarming Charm, providing a bonus die on Subterfuge rolls where the Halfling's small stature and non-threatening appearance work in their favor.

Halflings will tell you there is no such thing as magic luck, only good preparation and a well kept hearth. Then the dice land their way again. Hearthluck bends small odds, keeps a Halfling out of the eye of trouble, and spreads good fortune to the people they feed. Primary: Dexterity + Stealth + Hearthluck Secondary: Charisma + Subterfuge + Hearthluck Extra mana: Attack only. 1 die per mana, up to your Hearthluck dots or Max Mana Per Turn, whichever comes first.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Reaction Type: Utility Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: Once per scene, after you roll, reroll a number of your own dice up to your Heritage dots.

Mana Cost: 1, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Dexterity + Stealth + Hearthluck Defense: None Effect: While attuned, add your Heritage dots to Stealth rolls.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Reaction Type: Debuff Use: Combat Range: One enemy in sight Dice Pool: Charisma + Subterfuge + Hearthluck Defense: None Effect: When the enemy rolls against you or an ally in an adjacent zone, roll your dice pool. Each success removes 1 success from their roll.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Downtime Type: Utility Use: Outside combat only Range: Allies who share the meal Dice Pool: Charisma + Subterfuge + Hearthluck Defense: None Effect: Cook a meal over a scene. On a success, each ally who shares it regains 1 Willpower. Once per session.
Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Reaction Type: Movement Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: After an attack against you fails, move to an adjacent zone at no AP cost.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Enhancement Use: Combat and outside combat Range: One ally in an adjacent zone Dice Pool: Charisma + Subterfuge + Hearthluck Defense: None Effect: Roll your dice pool. The ally adds your successes, up to your Heritage dots, as bonus dice on their next roll.

Mana Cost: 4, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Attuned Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Dexterity + Stealth + Hearthluck Defense: Perception + Awareness Effect: Roll when you attune. While attuned, an enemy you have not attacked this scene must beat your successes with Perception + Awareness before they can target you.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Debuff Use: Combat Range: One target in sight Dice Pool: Charisma + Subterfuge + Hearthluck Defense: Composure + Insight Effect: The target resists with Composure + Insight. If you beat them, they suffer penalty dice equal to your extra successes on their next roll.

Mana Cost: 5, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, once per turn you may reroll one failed roll of your own.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Reaction Type: Enhancement Use: Combat and outside combat Range: One ally in sight Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: When the ally fails a roll, they reroll it. You take a penalty die on your next roll.

Mana Cost: 6, upkeep 5 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Utility, Persistent Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: Dexterity + Stealth + Hearthluck Defense: Perception + Awareness Effect: Roll when cast. While maintained, enemies must beat your successes with Perception + Awareness to notice you at all. It ends when you attack or take damage.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Instant Type: Debuff Use: Combat Range: One enemy in sight Dice Pool: Charisma + Subterfuge + Hearthluck Defense: Composure + Insight Effect: The target resists with Composure + Insight. If you beat them, their next roll automatically fails unless they spend 1 Willpower.
