Primary Dexterity + Martial Arts Secondary Perception + Dodge Default Ability Flowing Breath Both Add your dots to rolls to resist pain, fear, or exhaustion, using breathing and meditation. Option A Redirect Combat Once per round, when your defense roll beats an adjacent melee attack, send the attacker stumbling 1 zone in any direction you choose, into an empty zone. Option B Still Water Combat Once per round, after a successful defense roll, move 1 zone for free. Default Ability Silk Step Both Add your dots to Acrobatics rolls. You can run along a wall for 1 zone, cross narrow ledges at full speed, and jump 1 extra zone. Option A Deflecting Palm Combat Add your dots to defense rolls against ranged attacks. Option B Sweeping Kick Combat A low kick knocks the target Prone instead of dealing damage. Default Ability Feather Fall Both For falling damage, count every fall as shorter by a number of zones (10 feet each) equal to your dots. Option A Pressure Point Combat On a hit, spend 1 AP: the target takes a flat penalty die on rolls using one limb for the rest of the scene. Option B Locking Hand Combat On a hit, spend 1 AP to leave the target Rooted until the end of their next turn. Default Ability Empty Hand Combat While unarmed, add your dots to defense rolls against armed enemies. Option A Counting River Combat On a hit, strike the same target a second time for free. They defend against that same attack roll. Option B Borrowed Force Combat Once per round, when your defense roll beats an adjacent melee attack, make a Counter. Add the attacker's weapon Rating to its damage. Default Ability Monk's Discipline Outside combat You can go without food or sleep for a number of days equal to your dots with no penalty. Option A Leaf on the Wind Combat Once per scene, a failed defense roll counts as a success. Option B Rising Kick Combat Leap 1 zone and attack. A hit knocks the target Prone. Default Ability One Inch Strike Combat Add your dots to the damage of any strike you make without moving that round. Option A Mountain Stillness Combat On a round you don't move, every attack against you takes a flat penalty die. Option B Snatch the Arrow Combat Once per round, when your defense roll beats a thrown or fired attack, catch it and send it back as a Counter at any target in sight. Default Ability Leaf Walking Both Each round, you can cross a number of zones equal to your dots over water, leaves, or branches too thin to hold you. Option A The Thousand Hand Form Combat Spend 3 AP: one attack roll against every enemy in all adjacent zones, then move 1 zone for free. Option B Enlightened Palm Combat Once per story, one unarmed strike has full Armor Penetration and full Magic Penetration, and counts as meeting the next-higher damage threshold.

The fist style built for holds and throws, done with a showman's flair. It builds on the Grapple and Takedown actions and the Grappled condition (no belt items or attacks; in Upkeep, Strength + Athletics to break free). Covers: grappling, throws, holds, slams, and anything that isn't nailed down (chairs, tables, ladders). Primary Strength + Martial Arts (or Athletics) Secondary Fortitude + Endurance Default Ability Crowd Favorite Outside combat An entrance, a taunt, a pose. Add your dots to rolls to work a crowd, intimidate someone before a fight, or sell a story. Option A Lock Up Combat On an unarmed hit, spend 1 AP: the target is Grappled by you instead of taking damage. Option B Body Slam Combat On an unarmed hit, the target is also knocked Prone. Default Ability Steel Chair Both Improvised objects (chairs, bottles, ladders, tables) count as proper weapons for you. Add half your dots to their damage. Option A Clothesline Combat If you moved at least 1 zone before attacking, a hit adds your dots to damage and knocks the target Prone. Option B Sleeper Hold Combat While you have someone Grappled, every Upkeep they fail to break free, they lose 2 AP that turn. Default Ability Kayfabe Outside combat You can fake a fight, a fall, or an injury well enough to fool anyone watching. Add your dots to Chicanery or Subterfuge rolls to stage anything physical. Option A Suplex Combat While grappling, spend 1 AP to slam your target: damage equal to your dots, the target is knocked Prone, and the grapple ends. Option B Dropkick Combat Leap 1 zone and attack. A hit pushes the target 1 zone. If you miss, you land Prone. Default Ability No-Sell Combat Once per scene, shrug off a hit. It counts as meeting one threshold lower (LDT becomes BDT; BDT does no damage). Option A Figure-Four Leglock Combat Every Upkeep your target stays Grappled by you, they take damage equal to your dots. When they break free, they're Rooted until the end of their next turn. Option B DDT Combat While grappling, spend 1 AP: damage equal to your dots, the target loses 2 AP on their next turn, and the grapple ends. Default Ability Face of the Match Outside combat Fans and rivals know your name. Add your dots to social rolls with anyone who loves a good fight. Once per story, call in a favor from a fan. Option A Piledriver Combat While grappling, spend 2 AP: damage equal to twice your dots, the target is knocked Prone, and the grapple ends. Option B Powerbomb Combat While grappling, spend 2 AP to throw your target 1 zone into another enemy. One attack roll against both. Everyone hit is knocked Prone, and the grapple ends. Default Ability Off the Top Rope Both From any height (a table, a balcony, a ledge), dive onto a target up to 2 zones away. Add your dots to the attack roll. You take no falling damage from the dive. Option A Chokeslam Combat Spend 2 AP: lift an adjacent target and slam them down. Damage equal to your dots, they're knocked Prone, and they lose 2 AP on their next turn. No grapple needed. Option B Signature Move Combat Name your finisher. Once per scene, a successful Grapple on a target at their -4 wound penalty or worse ends their fight: they submit or are knocked out (Incapacitated). Default Ability Undisputed Champion Both Once per story, declare a bout a title match. For the rest of the scene, you can't be pinned, made to submit, or knocked out by non-lethal means. Option A The Finish Combat While grappling, spend 3 AP: damage equal to three times your dots, counted as meeting the next-higher damage threshold. The grapple ends. Option B Tag Team Combat When an adjacent ally attacks a target you have Grappled, they add your dots to their attack roll.

Patience, breath control, and a called shot that never needed calling. Covers: shortbows, longbows, recurves, crossbows. Primary Dexterity + Ranged Secondary Perception + Awareness Default Ability Hunter's Eye Outside combat Add your dots to rolls to track, stalk, or read animal sign. Option A Steady Draw Combat Add your dots to attack rolls made without moving that round. Option B Ready Nock Combat Add your dots to initiative while holding a bow. Default Ability Fletcher's Craft Outside combat You can make arrows and string bows from raw materials, about a quiver's worth of arrows in an hour. Option A Pinning Shot Combat On a hit, spend 1 AP to leave the target Rooted until the end of their next turn. Option B Cover Shot Combat Spend 1 AP: an ally within your range adds your dots to their next defense roll. Default Ability Quiver Belt Both You get one extra Belt slot (slot 4), for special arrows only. Drawing from it costs no AP. Option A Arcing Shot Combat Ignore cover. You can also hit a target you can't see if an ally can see it. Option B Silent Shot Combat Shooting doesn't give away your position if you're hidden. Add your dots to Stealth rolls right after a shot. Default Ability Trick Arrows Both You know how to rig rope arrows (a line between two zones that anyone can cross), smoke, noisemakers, and blunt arrows that deal kinetic damage. Option A Marksman's Patience Combat Spend your whole Action aiming. Your next shot adds twice your dots to the attack roll. Option B Twin Nock Combat One attack roll against two targets within range. Default Ability Long Eye Combat Ignore the -2 dice penalty for half cover. Option A Volley Combat Spend 2 AP: one attack roll against a target zone and every zone adjacent to it. Option B Heart Seeker Combat A called shot to a vital spot has full Armor Penetration. Default Ability Eagle Eye Both You see clearly at great distances, enough to read a sign a mile away. Option A Splitting Shot Combat When you hit, the arrow keeps going and also hits the next creature in a straight line behind the target, using the same attack roll. Option B The Last Arrow Combat Once per scene, re-roll a missed shot at your full pool. Default Ability Wind's Voice Both You always know what the wind and weather will do. Your arrows ignore penalties from wind, weather, and magical concealment. Option A The Thousand Arrow Storm Combat Spend 3 AP: one attack roll against every enemy you can see within range. Option B One True Shot Combat Once per story, an arrow automatically hits anything you can see and meets its ADT.

Fast target acquisition, snap shots, and drawing before the other side clears leather. Covers: pistols, revolvers, derringers, flintlock pistols. Primary Dexterity + Ranged Secondary Perception + Awareness Default Ability Gunsmith's Hands Outside combat You can clean, maintain, and repair hand guns and cast your own bullets. Add your dots to rolls to fix or identify firearms. Option A Fast Draw Combat Drawing a holstered hand gun costs no AP. Add your dots to initiative while one is holstered. Option B Point Blank Combat Add your dots to damage against an adjacent target. Default Ability Trick Shooting Outside combat Coins in the air, candle wicks, bottles off a fence. Add your dots to rolls to show off your shooting. Option A Double Tap Combat One attack roll fires twice at one target, and they defend against it twice. Option B Hip Fire Combat Add your dots to attack rolls made after moving that round. Default Ability Speed Loader Combat You get one extra Belt slot (slot 4), for ammunition only. Reloading from it costs no AP. Option A Disarm Shot Combat A called shot to the hand or weapon that hits makes the target drop it into an adjacent zone. Option B Covering Fire Combat Spend 1 AP: an ally within your range adds your dots to their next defense roll. Default Ability Two Guns Combat Wield a hand gun in each hand. When you fire both, add your dots to that one attack roll. Option A Ricochet Combat Bank a shot off a hard surface to ignore cover. Option B Gunslinger's Volley Combat One attack roll against two targets within range. Default Ability Reputation Outside combat Your name gets around saloons and frontier towns. Add your dots to rolls to intimidate, and most people think twice before drawing on you. Option A Fan the Hammer Combat Spend 2 AP: one attack roll fires up to three times, at any mix of targets in range. Each shot is defended separately. Option B Dead Eye Combat A called shot to a vital spot that hits counts as meeting the next-higher damage threshold. Default Ability Showdown Combat You win every initiative tie, and you act before any enemy you can see who starts combat with a weapon holstered. Option A Empty the Chamber Combat Once per scene, spend all your remaining AP on one shot at one target, adding twice your dots to the damage. Option B Last Stand Combat While you're at your -2 wound penalty or worse, add your dots to attack rolls. Default Ability Bullet Time Combat Once per scene, act for one turn as if you had the full 6 AP. Option A The Last Gunslinger Combat Spend 3 AP: one attack roll against every enemy you can see within range. Option B One Bullet, One Truth Combat Once per story, a shot automatically hits anything you can see and meets its ADT.

Bracing, controlling recoil, and putting enough lead downrange that cover stops mattering. Covers: rifles, muskets, shotguns, machine guns, cannons, heavy support weapons. Primary Fortitude + Ranged Secondary Strength + Athletics Default Ability Gunner's Hands Outside combat You can haul, mount, and maintain heavy weapons, and you carry a large gun without slowing down. Option A Brace Combat Add your dots to attack rolls made without moving that round. Option B Scope In Combat Add your dots to called shots. Default Ability Demolition Sense Outside combat Add your dots to rolls to find structural weak points, where to breach a wall, or the best firing position. Option A Suppressing Fire Combat Spend 1 AP: one attack roll at a target zone and every zone adjacent to it. It deals no damage, but every enemy there takes a flat penalty die on their next roll, whether you hit or not. Option B Knockback Combat A hit pushes the target 1 zone away. Default Ability Ammo Belt Combat You get one extra Belt slot (slot 4), for ammunition only. Reloading from it costs no AP. Option A Armor Piercing Combat Your shots have Armor Penetration equal to half your dots. Option B Field Repair Both Clear a jam or fix a damaged gun for 1 AP in combat. Outside combat, add your dots to repair rolls. Default Ability Dug In Combat On a round you don't move, add half your dots to your BDT against ranged attacks. Option A Wide Blast Combat One attack roll against every zone directly and diagonally forward of you. Option B Long Shot Combat Your shots punch through thin cover such as wood, plaster, or a thin wall: a target with full cover behind it has only half cover. Default Ability Quartermaster's Eye Outside combat One look at an enemy camp tells you roughly their numbers, gear, and supplies. Option A Breach Combat A shot destroys a door, a section of wooden wall, or one piece of cover. Option B Walking Fire Combat Spend 2 AP: one attack roll against every enemy in a straight line within range. Default Ability Unshakeable Combat On a round you don't move, enemy effects can't push you, knock you Prone, or make you lose AP. Option A Devastator Combat A hit lowers the target's Armor by 2 for the rest of the scene. Option B Scorched Line Combat Once per round, a shot at a target you've already hit this scene has full Armor Penetration. Default Ability One-Man Battery Both You can load, aim, and fire siege weapons (cannons, ballistae) alone, with no crew. Option A The Siege Breaker Combat Spend 3 AP: one attack roll against every enemy within 2 zones of a target zone. All cover in that area is destroyed. Option B Last Belt Combat Once per story, one attack automatically hits every enemy in your line of sight and meets at least their LDT.

Magic in Terrana is not a gift handed to a chosen few. It is a force that moves through the world and through every living thing in it. Mana cycles through the soil, the sky, and the blood. Learning to shape it is less like discovering a talent and more like learning to breathe deliberately. Anyone willing to put in the work can reach it. Very few reach the higher ranks. This chapter covers four kinds of magic. Battle Aura pours mana through the body and weapon and pairs with the Martial Combat Styles of Chapter 12 . Part One covers the seven casting schools: the combat-legal disciplines any character can learn through training, study, and hard-earned experience. Part Two covers combination magic: spells that emerge when two or more schools are cast together as one effect, producing things neither school could achieve alone. Part Three covers circle magic: ritual-based magic that works outside the seven schools and outside the combat turn structure entirely. Every spell entry in this chapter follows the same format. Mana cost. Speed. Type. Range. Dice pool. Effect. The description is flavor. The effect block is mechanical law. If an entry does not answer your question, flag it specifically so the rule can be refined through future play. Mana itself (your Mana Pool, Max Mana Per Turn, recovery, Mana Burn, attuned and committed mana, and running dry) is covered in Chapter 11 .

When casting a spell, the basic dice pool is Attribute plus Magical Ability plus dots in the relevant school, up to the spell's rank. The spell entry states which Attribute and Ability apply. Mana spent to enhance a roll adds 1 die per mana, declared before rolling, assigned to either the attack roll or the damage roll. Not both at once. The amount of mana that can enhance a roll is capped at your dots in that school or your M/T, whichever is lower.

s: What Every Spell Entry Tells You
t: Mana Cost: Total mana to cast Speed: Instant, Reaction, or Extended Type: One or more keywords describing the spell's function Range: Target zone, self, or AoE shape Dice Pool: Exact roll to make Effect: The mechanical outcome Description: Flavor text The defensive roll is always stated in the Effect. If a spell entry does not name what the target rolls to resist, flag it specifically so the entry can be corrected.

A target being attacked by magic chooses their own defense unless the spell explicitly says otherwise. Each spell entry lists the default defense, which is the roll that makes the most sense for what the spell physically does: Dexterity + Dodge: getting out of the way of bolts, projectiles, spikes, grasping vines, and other targeted attacks Strength + Athletics: bracing against being pushed, pulled, or dragged, and breaking free once held Dexterity + Acrobatics: keeping your footing on slick or shifting ground and landing safely from a fall Fortitude + Endurance: resisting effects that work on the body, such as cold, poison, exhaustion, burning terrain, and mana drain A defender can also try a situational defense when it fits, such as catching a large thrown object or bracing to tank it. Counter-magic follows the Magical Resistance rules below.

A Persistent spell has a duration counted in turns. Each Upkeep Phase the countdown ticks down by 1. Paying the upkeep cost during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn. The upkeep cost for any spell is the spell's mana cost minus 1. Countdown spells are a subtype of Persistent. Duration equals half the total mana spent, rounded up. Paying upkeep (cost minus 1) during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for one turn. The countdown resumes on any turn upkeep is not paid.

When a spell targets a character who wants to resist its effect, the defender rolls a resistance pool that includes their dots in the relevant magic. Most resistance rolls are written as Fortitude plus Endurance with the caster's school dots added. Resistance is a separate roll, not a comparison against the attacker's successes. The spell entry names the defensive roll.

Additional mana beyond a spell's base cost can be spent to either add dice to the roll or augment the spell's effect. Both options cannot be chosen at once. Declare before rolling. For combination spells, augmentation costs extra mana scaled to the number of schools involved: 2-school spells cost 2 mana per augmentation, 3-school cost 3, and so on. Mana Bleed: Any effect that makes a target lose mana during an Upkeep Phase is Mana Bleed. Most Mana Bleed comes from Shade Magic and the combination spells built on it. Losing mana all at once from a single hit is a drain, not a bleed.

A caster does not have open access to every spell they know during combat. Spells must be prepared ahead of time. Preparation happens outside of combat and represents the caster arranging their intent, attunement, and focus before the fight. The number of spells a character can have prepared at any time is equal to their dots in Intelligence. A character with 3 Intelligence can have 3 spells prepared. A character with 5 can have 5. Prepared spells can be swapped freely outside of combat. There is no cost and no time restriction beyond being out of a fight. In combat, the prepared list is fixed until the fight ends. A spell from any school the character knows can fill a prepared slot, including combination spells the character meets the prerequisites for. The prepared list does not need to be filled entirely. A character may go into a fight with fewer prepared spells than their Intelligence allows.

Every dot in a casting school also grants a default ability. It comes with the dot automatically, in addition to the spell option chosen for that dot. Default abilities come in three kinds. Some cost mana each time they are used. Some are attuned: they hold part of your M/T for as long as they are active, and ending one returns that mana to your M/T during the following Upkeep Phase. Some are permanent improvements to how that school's spells work. The seven casting schools are the combat-legal magical disciplines available to any character willing to train in them. Each is a standalone knowledge tracked under Magical Knowledges on the sheet. Each runs from Core (dot 1) through Cosmic (dot 7), with two technique options available at each dot. When a dot is purchased the player chooses one option. The unchosen option can be bought later for Rank x2 XP. A school designated as Primary costs new dot times 5 XP. Any other school costs new dot times 6 XP. Every school taken in Step 11 of character creation is Primary and marked with a P; a school gained any other way is Secondary and marked with an S. The Rank scale for Magical Knowledges is: Core (1) / Terrestrial (2) / Aerial (3) / Lunar (4) / Stellar (5) / Galactic (6) / Cosmic (7).

Battle Aura is not one of the seven casting schools. It is a separate discipline of physical enhancement that runs mana through the body and weapon. It can be used alongside any of the seven schools but is learned and tracked independently under Magical Knowledges. Battle Aura does not produce elemental effects on its own. From Rank 4 it can carry the energy of one casting school through imbuing (see Imbuing below). Mana assigned to Battle Aura can go to either the attack roll or the damage roll. Declare before rolling. Starting at Rank 4, techniques may be activated by spending Willpower instead of their mana cost. Rank 4 costs 1 Willpower, Rank 5 costs 2 Willpower, Rank 6 costs 3 Willpower, and Rank 7 costs 4 Willpower. Additional mana can still be spent on top of a Willpower activation for further enhancement. Spending Willpower this way is not an action and does not cost AP. It is separate from the 1 Willpower you may spend each turn to push or reroll ( Chapter 11 ), and each point paid marks an X on your Willpower row.

Like the seven casting schools, every Battle Aura dot grants a default ability. It comes with the dot automatically, in addition to the technique chosen for that dot. As with the casting schools, the unchosen technique can be bought later for Rank x2 XP.

Battle Aura is built to work with every Combat Style. Wherever a Battle Aura dice pool lists Attribute + Ability + Combat Style, use the Attribute and Ability of the Combat Style you are fighting with, plus your dots in that Style. Armor Penetration ignores points of the armor portion of a target’s DT. Magic Penetration ignores points of the portion added by spells, enchantments, or magical gear. Penetration from different sources adds together, but neither can lower its portion below 0. Several Combat Styles grant Armor Penetration of their own, and Aura Edge (Rank 2) adds both kinds to every weapon and unarmed attack. The Martial Combat Styles chapter has the full rules.

Starting at Rank 4, a practitioner can imbue an attack with the energy of one of the seven casting schools: Fire, Water, Air, Earth, Nature, Bright, or Shade. This is not combination magic. Combination magic weaves casting schools together into a new spell. Imbuing simply carries a school's energy on a Battle Aura technique or a weapon or unarmed attack. An imbued attack takes on the nature of that school. A Fire-imbued strike is a fire attack, a Water-imbued strike is a water attack, and so on, including Elemental Advantages and that school's mana assignment rule (see Imbuing Attacks). The practitioner may spend additional mana on the imbued attack up to their Battle Aura dots plus their dots in the imbued school, or their M/T, whichever comes first. An attack can be imbued with only one school at a time, and the practitioner needs at least 1 dot in the school they imbue.

Empowered Flight is unlocked at Rank 6. Taking off costs 6 mana, or 3 Willpower. Moving at altitude costs an upkeep of 5 mana each Upkeep Phase, and hovering in place costs half that, rounded up (3 mana). While flying you move at double your normal movement. Taking damage that meets your BDT while airborne requires a Dexterity + Athletics roll against the damage dealt. On a failure you begin to fall, land during your next Upkeep Phase, and take falling damage as normal. Winged flyers use the Athletics specialty Flight instead and need no mana. Anything that flies moves at double its normal movement. Mechanical flight (machines, vehicles, and devices) must use all of its movement every turn or begin to fall. The practitioner can feel and deliberately direct their fighting spirit for the first time. The enhancement is small but real. Default Ability: Surge (1 mana per die, Instant) Push fighting spirit into your body for one Strength, Dexterity, or Fortitude roll that isn’t an attack, such as lifting, climbing, sprinting, or breaking free of a grapple. Each mana adds 1 die, up to the usual cap. Outside of combat, from Rank 2 on, one Surge can carry you through a whole extended task, such as a long climb or a day of hauling.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Enhancement, Attack Range: Adjacent zone Dice Pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style. Mana spent adds to declared roll portion. Effect: Channel fighting spirit into unarmed strikes. Declare before rolling whether mana adds bonus dice to the attack roll or the damage roll. 1 mana per bonus die. Mana spent this way is capped at your Battle Aura dots or your M/T, whichever comes first. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. The practitioner's fists or feet are coated in fighting spirit. Lasts for this action only.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Enhancement, Attack Range: Your weapon's reach Dice Pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style. Mana spent adds to declared roll portion. Effect: Channel fighting spirit into a wielded weapon. Declare before rolling whether mana adds bonus dice to the attack roll or the damage roll. 1 mana per bonus die. The weapon's base rating is enhanced by the aura coating for this action. Mana spent this way is capped at your Battle Aura dots or your M/T, whichever comes first. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. The wielded weapon is coated in fighting spirit for a single strike. The practitioner can sustain their Battle Aura across multiple turns. Enhancement becomes persistent. They begin developing defensive applications. Default Ability: Aura Edge (Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active) Your weapon and unarmed attacks gain Armor Penetration and Magic Penetration equal to half your Battle Aura dots, rounded up. They ignore that many points of the armor portion of a target’s DT, and that many points of the portion added by magic. This stacks with Armor Penetration from your Combat Style.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Persistent Range: Self Dice Pool: Fortitude + Endurance Effect: Channel fighting spirit into the body to enhance Fortitude. The practitioner adds mana spent to their BDT for as long as the effect is maintained. Upkeep cost is 1 mana per Upkeep Phase. Can be maintained alongside other Battle Aura effects. The body hardens with concentrated fighting spirit, reinforcing it against incoming strikes.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Persistent Range: Self, wielded weapon Dice Pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style. Mana spent adds to declared roll portion. Effect: Sustain a Battle Aura coating on a wielded weapon across multiple turns. Declare before the first activation whether bonus dice are assigned to attack or damage rolls. This assignment is fixed for the duration. Upkeep cost is 1 mana per Upkeep Phase. The effect can be dropped and reactivated to change the assignment. The weapon is coated in a sustained layer of fighting spirit that persists between strikes. The fighting spirit becomes reactive. The practitioner can respond to incoming attacks defensively. The aura becomes more visually distinct at this rank, often taking on a color unique to the practitioner. From this rank onward the practitioner may always spend additional mana beyond a technique's base cost to add further bonus dice, up to their M/T. Default Ability: Aura Read (2 mana, Instant) Read the fighting spirit of one creature you can see within a number of zones equal to your Battle Aura dots. Roll Perception + Awareness + Battle Aura. On a success you learn its highest Combat Style rank, its Battle Aura rank, and whether it means to fight you right now. With 3 or more successes you also learn whether it is hiding how strong it is.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Reaction Type: Defense Range: Self Dice Pool: Fortitude + Endurance + Battle Aura Effect: When struck by an attack that meets the practitioner's BDT, spend 3 mana as a Reaction to channel fighting spirit into the body at the moment of impact. Roll Fortitude + Endurance + Battle Aura dots. Each success reduces the incoming damage value by 1. Triggers after the attacker's damage roll but before damage is applied. A sudden flare of fighting spirit at the moment of impact, hardening the body against the blow.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Reaction Type: Attack Range: The attacker, in an adjacent zone Dice Pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura Effect: When taking a point of damage from an attacker in an adjacent zone, spend 3 mana as a Reaction to immediately return a strike against the attacker. Roll as a standard melee attack. Additional mana may be declared toward attack or damage as normal. The counter resolves after the incoming attack is applied. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. The practitioner channels their fighting spirit into an immediate counter strike following damage from a melee attack. Fighting spirit can be projected beyond the body for the first time. Attacks no longer require physical contact. The practitioner sends their aura forward in a straight line from their fist, foot, or weapon. They can also imbue their attacks with the energy of one casting school (see Imbuing). Default Ability: Aura Hand (3 mana, Instant) Reach out with projected fighting spirit up to 2 zones away and roll Strength + Athletics + Battle Aura. Push or pull a creature 1 zone into an empty zone (Defend: Strength + Athletics), or lift, move, or hold an object you could lift with your own hands, such as opening a door or catching a falling ally.

Mana Cost: 4, or 1 Willpower Speed: Instant Type: Attack Range: Ranged, straight line from caster through any number of zones Dice Pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura Effect: Project fighting spirit forward in a straight line. The wave travels through every zone in that line. Every target in the line is hit and defends separately. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets. Damage is rolled separately after a successful hit. Additional mana may be spent to add bonus dice to attack or damage before rolling. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. A visible wave of fighting spirit launched forward in a straight line.

Mana Cost: 4, or 1 Willpower Speed: Reaction Type: Defense Range: Self Dice Pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura Effect: When targeted by a ranged or melee attack, spend 4 mana or 1 Willpower as a Reaction to project fighting spirit outward as a deflecting force. Roll Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura dots. Each success reduces the incoming attack's success total by 1. If the defender's successes meet or exceed the attacker's the attack is fully deflected. Usable against both physical and magical attacks. The practitioner projects their fighting spirit outward at the moment of an incoming attack. The practitioner can now project their fighting spirit outward in a cone. Default Ability: Battle Presence (Permanent) People near you can feel your fighting spirit without being touched. Add your Battle Aura dots to rolls to intimidate, and to your own rolls to resist fear.

Mana Cost: 5, or 2 Willpower Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE Range: AoE-Cone Dice Pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura Effect: Project fighting spirit outward in a cone covering all zones directly in front of and diagonally forward of the practitioner. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets in the cone. Each target defends separately. Damage is rolled separately after a successful hit. Additional mana may be spent to add bonus dice to attack or damage. Can hit allies. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. A fan of fighting spirit projected outward from the body, covering a wide forward arc.

Mana Cost: 5, or 2 Willpower Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Persistent Range: One target in an adjacent zone Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Battle Aura Effect: Channel fighting spirit into an ally, temporarily enhancing one physical attribute (Strength, Dexterity, or Fortitude) by a number of dots equal to successes rolled, up to the practitioner's Battle Aura dots. Duration maintained by upkeep of 4 mana per Upkeep Phase. The practitioner must remain within one zone of the target to maintain the effect. The practitioner channels their fighting spirit directly into an ally, temporarily bolstering their physical capabilities. The practitioner gains Empowered Flight. Attacks can be projected in two directions simultaneously. The aura can now protect others. Default Ability: Empowered Flight (see Flight above) You can fly by projecting fighting spirit downward, following the Flight rules at the start of this section.

Mana Cost: 6, or 3 Willpower Speed: Instant Type: Attack Range: Ranged, two straight lines from the caster in any two directions Dice Pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura Effect: Project fighting spirit in two straight lines simultaneously. Each line can point in any direction. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets in both lines. Each target defends separately. Damage is rolled separately after a successful hit. Additional mana may be spent to add bonus dice to attack or damage. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. Two simultaneous waves of fighting spirit projected in different directions.

Mana Cost: 6, or 3 Willpower Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Persistent Range: Self and up to two allies in adjacent zones Dice Pool: Fortitude + Endurance + Battle Aura Effect: Project fighting spirit outward to cover the practitioner and up to two allies in adjacent zones in a protective aura. Each protected target adds the practitioner's Battle Aura dots to their BDT for as long as the effect is maintained. Upkeep cost is 5 mana per Upkeep Phase. The practitioner must remain within one zone of each protected target. If a target moves beyond one zone away the effect on that target ends immediately. The practitioner extends their fighting spirit outward to cover allies in a protective layer. The practitioner has achieved complete mastery. The aura is a constant visible presence felt by anyone nearby. Techniques may be activated by spending 4 Willpower. The practitioner can release their fighting spirit in all directions simultaneously or concentrate it into a single devastating output. Default Ability: Sovereign Aura (Attuned: holds 4 of your M/T while active) Enemies within a number of zones equal to your Battle Aura dots, whose Battle Aura and Combat Style ratings are all lower than your Battle Aura dots, roll Composure + Presence when they first come into range. If they roll fewer successes than your Battle Aura dots, they lose 1 die on all rolls while they stay in range. Outside of combat, anyone affected won’t start a fight with you unless they’re cornered.

Mana Cost: 7, or 4 Willpower Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE Range: AoE, all zones adjacent to the practitioner Dice Pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura Effect: Release fighting spirit in an explosive burst radiating outward in all directions. Every target in any zone adjacent to the practitioner is hit. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets. Each target defends separately. Damage is rolled and applied to all targets hit successfully. Additional mana may be spent to add bonus dice to attack or damage. All targets, whether damaged or not, are pushed one zone away from the caster. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. A total release of fighting spirit in all directions at once. Every nearby target is pushed back.

Mana Cost: 7, or 4 Willpower Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Enhancement, Persistent Range: Self Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Battle Aura Effect: Channel fighting spirit into complete physical transcendence. Once active, all three physical attributes (Strength, Dexterity, and Fortitude) are enhanced by a number of dots equal to successes rolled, up to the practitioner's Battle Aura dots. All existing Battle Aura persistent effects are maintained at no additional upkeep cost for the duration. Upkeep cost is 6 mana per Upkeep Phase or 2 Willpower per scene. Ends immediately if the practitioner is incapacitated. A total channeling of fighting spirit into the body simultaneously enhancing all physical attributes. Combination magic is what happens when two or more casting schools are woven together as a unified effect. The result is a distinct spell neither school could produce alone. Every combination spell is learned separately. Meeting the prerequisites does not automatically grant access to the spell.

No single casting school can heal. Healing comes only from combination magic. Bright Magic on its own does not heal anyone. A healing spell does not repair damage directly. Radiant energy surrounds the target as they are given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. The healing does not begin on its own. The target spends points from the pool during their own turn. Spending PHP does not take an action.

Every healing spell names its healing tier. The tier decides what each point in the pool can do. Each point spent buys one option from that tier. To slake a damage box is to lower it one type (Aggravated to Lethal, or Lethal to Bashing). To neutralize a box is to remove it. Basic: neutralize 1 Bashing, or slake 1 Lethal to Bashing. Cannot affect Aggravated. Advanced: neutralize 2 Bashing, neutralize 1 Lethal, or slake 1 Aggravated to Lethal. Expert: neutralize 4 Bashing, neutralize 2 Lethal, or neutralize 1 Aggravated. Master healing regrows lost limbs and is never used in combat. Resurrection is the only tier above Master (see Resurrection).

Every healing spell states how long its pool lasts. Many pools last until the end of the target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. Stronger spells let the energy linger using the countdown mechanic: the pool lasts a number of turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up, and paying the spell's upkeep (mana cost minus 1) during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn. When the pool ends, any unused points are lost.

Death in Terrana is not always the end, but coming back is rare. The Countdown: When a character dies without choosing to, the mana they held at the moment of death stays in the body and counts down by 1 each day. While any remains, the soul can still be called back. Rising Undead: If the count reaches 0 and the body was not cremated, it soaks up the ambient mana around it and rises as mindless undead. Sentient undead are far rarer: they take an act of a god, or a personality implanted by a powerful Shade user. A Chosen Death: A character who chose Blaze of Glory chose their death and cannot be resurrected. The Spell: Only one spell can call someone back: Resurrection, a six-school combination of Fire, Water, Air, Nature, Bright, and Shade at 6 dots each (Six-School Combinations). Very few people alive have the training to cast it, which is why resurrection is precious and never routine. Healing magic can repair a body, but only Resurrection can bring back the person in it.

A weapon or unarmed attack can carry the energy of a casting school in two ways: Battle Aura imbuing, available from Battle Aura Rank 4, and Augmentation, a circle magic that builds magic into weapons with an augment slot. Either way, an attack can carry only one school's energy at a time. When an attack carries a school's energy, that school's fixed rule decides which roll its mana can go to: Fire: Damage roll only Water: Either roll Air: Attack roll only Earth: Damage roll only Nature: Either roll Bright: Attack roll only Shade: Damage roll only Battle Aura: Either roll Imbuing is not a spell. It does not produce a spell block with type, range, or defensive roll. It is mana fed into an existing physical attack.

The five combat magic schools do not exist in isolation. They interact with one another in structured ways, and understanding those interactions is one of the most important things a caster can learn. Some elements carry inherent advantages against others, making attacks more effective, walls harder to break, and spell effects more difficult to resist. Ignoring this will cost you. Using it well can turn a fight before your opponent realizes what is happening. Every element has a strong advantage against one other element and a moderate advantage against a second. The reverse is also true: every element is weakened against two others. These relationships are fixed and apply any time two elements interact in combat, whether through direct spell attacks, elemental walls and shields, terrain effects, or combination spells that carry elemental tags. An advantage needs something elemental on the other side to oppose: a wall, shield, terrain, or elemental effect, or a creature with an elemental type. A summoned water elemental, for example, is struck by Air Magic with advantage and by Fire Magic with disadvantage.

A strong advantage (+2) means the attacking element gains 2 additional dice on rolls made against the target element. This applies to attack rolls when the spell directly opposes an elemental effect, and to the damage roll when striking a target who is protected by or empowered with the opposing element. When attacking an elemental wall or shield, the defending element's DT bonus is also affected: the shielded target gains double the bonus against an element it is strong against, and half the bonus against an element it is weak against. A moderate advantage (+1) works the same way but adds only 1 die. It is still meaningful, particularly at higher ranks where the difference of a single die can push a result past a Damage Threshold. These bonuses apply in both directions. A Fire mage attacking a Water wall is rolling at a disadvantage. A Water mage attacking a Fire wall is rolling with 2 extra dice. Players and Storytellers should keep this in mind when choosing which spell to cast into which situation.

The diagram below shows all five elemental relationships. Solid outer arrows represent the +2 strong advantage, flowing clockwise around the star. Dashed inner arrows represent the +1 moderate advantage, cutting across to the element two steps away. Reading the diagram: each element's strong advantage points to the element immediately clockwise on the outer ring. Each element's moderate advantage points to the element two steps clockwise via the inner star line.

Fire: +2 against Nature, +1 against Earth Nature: +2 against Earth, +1 against Air Earth: +2 against Air, +1 against Water Air: +2 against Water, +1 against Fire Water: +2 against Fire, +1 against Nature Bright Magic and Shade Magic have no elemental strengths or weaknesses. They do not interact with the elemental advantage system. Their advantages and disadvantages are tied entirely to living and undead targets rather than to opposing elemental forces. Combination spells carry the elemental tags of every school used to cast them. A combination spell using Fire and Water, for example, is both strong and weak depending on what it encounters. The Storyteller and player should note which schools are involved in a combination cast and apply the relevant bonuses and penalties accordingly.

The seven casting schools are Fire, Water, Air, Earth, Nature, Bright, and Shade. Each runs from Core (1) to Cosmic (7). Every rank grants a Default Ability and offers two spells: choose one when you buy the dot.

Fire Magic is the school of combustion, heat, and destruction by burning. Its spells deal damage directly and impose the Burning condition. Fire is aggressive and direct. It gains mana assignment to the damage roll only. It carries elemental advantages against Nature and Earth and is weakest against Water and Air. Fire Magic has elemental interactions with elemental defenses and conjurations: +2 against Nature, +1 against Earth, -1 against Air, -2 against Water. The practitioner can kindle and hurl small flames. Fire at this rank is close-range and straightforward. There is nothing subtle about it. Default Ability: Heat Tolerance (Permanent) Damage you take from ordinary, non-magical heat and flame is halved (rounded down), and you can briefly handle hot coals or metal.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, Fire Range: Adjacent zone Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Fire dots Effect: Launch a small flame at a target in an adjacent zone. On a hit the target takes damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. Outside of combat, Ignite can set an unattended combustible object on fire, and that fire burns as ordinary flame. A flick of concentrated heat thrown directly at a target.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Utility, Fire Range: Self / touch Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Fire dots Effect: Set fire to any flammable material the caster touches or holds. Alternatively, light a small flame on something that can burn, such as a torch or candle. Once lit it is ordinary fire and burns as normal. Cannot be used as an attack. Can destroy documents, ignite traps, or light a campfire with one success. The most basic application of fire. Make a thing burn. The caster can project fire to greater distances and begin to shape it into persistent effects. Default Ability: Warmth (Attuned: holds 1 of your M/T while active) You and allies in adjacent zones are unaffected by non-magical cold and cannot gain the Chilled condition from weather.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, Fire Range: Targeted Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Fire dots Effect: A bolt of fire strikes a single target at any range within line of sight. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes and applies the Burning condition. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge or appropriate cover. A reliable aimed bolt. Goes where it is aimed. Burns what it hits.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Utility, Persistent, Fire Range: Zone Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Fire dots Effect: Cover a zone in low flames. Any target entering or remaining in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase. Failure deals 1 damage and applies the Burning condition. Water Magic applied to the zone reduces cast successes by the Water caster's successes. Upkeep: 1. The ground burns. Not intensely. But it burns. Fire becomes a cone and a shield. The caster can now catch themselves with it. Default Ability: Reach of Flame (Permanent) Your Fire spells with a range of Adjacent zone can target a zone one step further away.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE, Fire Range: AoE-Cone Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Fire dots Effect: A cone of flame erupts from the caster, covering all zones directly in front and diagonally forward. Caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets. Each target defends separately. All targets hit gain the Burning condition. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. A broad expulsion of fire from the caster's hands or mouth.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Conjuration, Persistent, Fire Range: Adjacent zone border Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Fire dots Effect: A wall of flame rises along a border between two zones. Any target attempting to cross the border must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or take damage equal to excess successes and gain the Burning condition. The wall provides cover to targets on either side. Water Magic reduces cast successes by the Water caster's successes. Upkeep: 2. A vertical sheet of fire that punishes anyone who walks through it. The caster can wrap themselves in fire as a persistent defense and project fire in straight lines. Default Ability: Flare (2 mana, Reaction) When an enemy in an adjacent zone attacks you, a flash of fire bursts from your body. That attack loses 2 dice.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, Fire Range: Ranged, straight line through any number of zones Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Fire dots Effect: A whip of concentrated flame projects in a straight line from the caster, hitting every target in that line. Caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets. Each target defends separately. All targets hit gain the Burning condition. Damage is rolled separately after a successful hit. A lash of fire that cuts a straight line through everything in its path.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Persistent, Fire Range: Self Dice Pool: Fortitude + Magic + Fire dots Effect: The caster wraps themselves in a sustained layer of fire. Any target who strikes the caster in melee takes damage equal to half the original cast successes (rounded down) and gains the Burning condition. The cloak also adds the cast successes to the caster's BDT against water-based attacks. Upkeep: 3. The caster burns. Anyone who reaches for them learns it immediately. Fire can be launched as a large explosion or concentrated into armor-piercing intensity. Default Ability: Searing (Permanent) Damage from your Fire spells ignores 1 point of the armor portion of a target's DT.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE, Fire Range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any targeted zone within line of sight Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Fire dots Effect: A sphere of fire detonates in a 2x2 zone area. Caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets in the area. Each target defends separately. All targets hit gain the Burning condition. Can hit allies. The caster may choose any adjacent 2x2 zone area within line of sight. The classic. A ball of fire that explodes on impact and covers the area.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, Armor Pen, Fire Range: Targeted Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Fire dots Effect: A focused lance of fire heated beyond normal flame burns through defenses. Carries Armor Pen: before rolling, declare additional mana toward Armor Pen. Every 2 mana reduces the armor portion of the target's DT by 1 for this attack. Target hit gains the Burning condition. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge or appropriate cover. Fire focused down to a point of intense penetration. The caster can rain fire from above and animate a sustained fire entity. Default Ability: Living Flame (Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active) Your body is wreathed in fire. Any target that hits you with a melee attack gains the Burning condition.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE, Fire Range: AoE, any number of adjacent zones chosen by caster, up to Fire dots Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Fire dots Effect: Fire falls from above across a number of zones up to the caster's Fire dots. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets in all chosen zones. Each target defends separately. All targets hit gain the Burning condition. The caster must be able to see or have previously visited every chosen zone. Water Magic in a targeted zone reduces cast successes in that zone by the Water caster's successes. The sky over multiple zones ignites. Everyone below learns at once.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Instant Type: Conjuration, Persistent, Fire Range: Any adjacent zone Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Fire dots Effect: Summons a fire elemental in an adjacent zone. It cannot act on the turn it is summoned. On subsequent turns the caster may command it to attack one target in its zone or an adjacent zone, using the caster's Fire dice pool. Any target it hits gains the Burning condition. The elemental has a Vitality pool equal to double the cast successes. Water Magic reduces the Vitality pool by the Water caster's successes. Upkeep: 5. A semi-autonomous entity of concentrated flame that attacks on command. Fire at this rank is an extinction event for a zone or a conflagration that envelops every target on the field. Default Ability: Heart of the Sun (Permanent) Burning applied by your Fire spells deals 1 Lethal on a successful resistance roll and 1 Aggravated on a failed one.

Mana Cost: 7 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE, Fire Range: All zones within line of sight Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Fire dots Effect: Fire envelops every zone the caster can see. Caster rolls once. Every target in every visible zone must defend. Each target defends separately. All targets hit gain the Burning condition. The caster's own zone is affected. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. The world, briefly, is on fire.

Mana Cost: 7 Speed: Instant Type: Utility, Persistent, Fire Range: Zone Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Fire dots Effect: The caster creates a fire that will not die naturally. It fills the zone permanently, dealing damage equal to cast successes to any target who enters or remains, and applying the Burning condition. It cannot be extinguished by normal means. Water Magic reduces cast successes by the Water caster's successes but cannot dispel it without matching or exceeding the successes entirely. If the successes are fully matched the Eternal Flame is extinguished. Upkeep: 6. A fire that stays. It does not go out. It does not diminish. It simply burns.

Water Magic is the school of fluid force, cold, and flow. Its spells deal damage, apply the Chilled condition, move targets, and can shift between offense and defense with notable flexibility. Water can assign mana to either the attack roll or the damage roll. It carries elemental advantages against Fire and Nature and is weakest against Air and Earth. Elemental interactions: +2 against Fire, +1 against Nature, -1 against Earth, -2 against Air. Water at this rank is a jet and a chill. The caster can hurl water with force and apply cold to surfaces or targets. Default Ability: Water Breathing (Attuned: holds 1 of your M/T while active) You can breathe underwater and swim at your normal movement.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, Water Range: Adjacent zone Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Water dots Effect: A high-pressure bolt of water hits a target in an adjacent zone. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. Water moving very fast in one direction. It hits hard.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, Utility, Water Range: Touch Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Water dots Effect: The caster applies intense cold through touch. Against an unwilling target this is a touch attack: on a hit the target takes damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. Outside of combat, Chill Touch can freeze a small amount of water, frost a surface, or chill food and drink, and the cold fades naturally. Cold applied directly. Not violence yet. Just cold. Water can be projected at range and used to create treacherous terrain. Default Ability: Purify (1 mana, Instant) Make up to a zone of water clean and safe to drink, or draw a few gallons of fresh water out of the air.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, CC, Water Range: Targeted Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Water dots Effect: A focused stream of pressurized water hits a single target within line of sight. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Any target hit must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or be pushed 1 zone away from the caster. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. A stream of water that pushes as hard as it hits.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Utility, Persistent, Water Range: Zone Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Water dots Effect: Freezes the surface of a zone with a thin layer of ice. The zone becomes difficult terrain. Any target entering or moving through the zone must roll Dexterity + Acrobatics vs cast successes or fall prone (Knocked Down condition). Fire Magic applied to the zone reduces cast successes by the Fire caster's successes. Upkeep: 1. The floor gets slick. The transition from upright to down is fast. The caster can reach further with ice and begin to use water as a reactive defense. Default Ability: Flowing Form (Permanent) You gain 1 bonus die on Dexterity + Dodge rolls against Fire Magic.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, Water Range: Targeted Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Water dots Effect: A lance of ice fires at a target within line of sight. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes and applies the Chilled condition. On 3+ excess successes the Chilled condition escalates to Frozen (the target cannot move at all and loses their movement action until freed, which requires either Fire Magic applied to them or a Strength + Athletics roll vs cast successes as an action). Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. Cold compressed to a point and thrown. It gets into the target in more ways than one.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Reaction Type: Defense, Water Range: Self Dice Pool: Fortitude + Magic + Water dots Effect: When an attack is declared against the caster, spend 3 mana as a Reaction to raise a barrier of rushing water. Roll Fortitude + Magic + Water dots. Each success adds 1 to the caster's DT against this specific attack. Against fire-based attacks, double the DT bonus from this roll. Against earth or nature-based attacks, the shield provides no bonus. Water intercedes between the caster and whatever is coming. Water can fully freeze targets and put out fire across a whole zone. Default Ability: Water Walking (Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active) You can move across the surface of water and other liquids as if it were solid ground.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, CC, Water Range: Targeted Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Water dots Effect: Water erupts from the ground around a target, instantly freezing them in place. Target must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes. On failure, the target gains the Frozen condition (cannot move, loses movement action, -2 dice to all rolls while frozen). On 3+ excess successes the target also takes damage equal to excess successes as the ice compresses. Fire Magic applied to the target reduces the successes on the freeze and can end it. Defend: Fortitude + Endurance. Sudden total freezing. Not cold. Frozen.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Utility, Water Range: Zone within line of sight Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Water dots Effect: Water floods a zone and puts out fire. Every Burning condition on targets in the zone ends. Each Fire Magic effect in the zone (walls, burning ground, fire conjurations) loses successes equal to the cast successes, and any reduced to 0 ends. On 3+ successes the zone also becomes difficult terrain until the start of the next Upkeep Phase. Every flame in the zone goes out at once. Water can draw targets toward the caster and form persistent body armor from ice. Default Ability: Deep Cold (Permanent) A target that gains the Chilled condition from your Water spells also loses their free move while Chilled.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, CC, Water Range: Targeted Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Water dots Effect: A wave of water crashes against a single target and drags them toward the caster. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Any target hit must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or be dragged 1 zone toward the caster per 2 excess successes (minimum 1 zone on failure). Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. A wave that hits a target and pulls them back with it.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Persistent, Water Range: Self Dice Pool: Fortitude + Magic + Water dots Effect: The caster encases themselves in a layer of magical ice. Add cast successes to the caster's BDT against all physical attacks. Additionally, the ice absorbs damage: the first time the caster would take damage each round, reduce that damage by the cast successes before applying it. Fire attacks deal double damage to the Ice Armor, reducing the BDT bonus by the fire damage dealt. Upkeep: 4. Ice plate. It holds until it is melted. Which takes work. Water at this rank can blanket multiple zones in ice and redirect incoming attacks. Default Ability: Slip Away (3 mana, Reaction) When you would be pushed, pulled, or dragged, you flow like water instead. Ignore the forced movement and move 1 zone in a direction of your choice.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE, Water Range: AoE, up to Water dots zones chosen by caster Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Water dots Effect: Ice and freezing wind blast across a number of zones up to the caster's Water dots. Caster rolls once. Every target in every chosen zone must defend. Each defends separately. All targets hit gain the Chilled condition. On 3+ excess successes, a target gains Frozen instead. Fire Magic in a targeted zone reduces cast successes in that zone. Defend: Fortitude + Endurance. Multiple zones become extremely cold and hostile all at once.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Reaction Type: Defense, Water Range: Self or adjacent ally Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Water dots Effect: When the caster or an adjacent ally is the target of a ranged attack or targeted spell, spend 6 mana as a Reaction. Roll Dexterity + Magic + Water dots. If the roll's successes exceed the attack's successes, the attack is redirected to a target of the caster's choice within range of the original attack. If the successes do not exceed the attack's, the attack proceeds normally. Cannot be used against melee attacks. An incoming attack gets turned around and aimed somewhere else. Water at this rank can flood an entire area or lock it permanently under ice. Default Ability: Absolute Zero (Permanent) Frozen conditions from your Water spells can only be ended by Fire Magic that exceeds your cast successes, and a Frozen target cannot use Reactions.

Mana Cost: 7 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE, Water Range: All zones within line of sight Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Water dots Effect: A massive wave floods every visible zone. Caster rolls once. Every target in every visible zone must defend. Each defends separately. All targets hit take damage equal to excess successes, gain the Chilled condition, and must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or be pushed 1 zone in the direction of the wave. After the water passes, all affected zones become difficult terrain as water and debris remain. Defend: Strength + Athletics. A wave fills everything that can be seen. There is nowhere to go.

Mana Cost: 7 Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Conjuration, Persistent, Water Range: Zone of caster's choice within line of sight Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Water dots Effect: A massive glacier rises and fills the target zone entirely. The zone is impassable without destroying sections of glacier (each section has Vitality equal to cast successes, and there are 4 sections). Targets inside when it forms are Frozen and Pinned until the ice is destroyed or melted. Fire Magic reduces the glacier's Vitality by the Fire caster's successes per turn applied. Upkeep: 6. A zone becomes a glacier all at once.

Air Magic is the school of wind, speed, and precision. Its spells excel at ranged attacks, movement disruption, and battlefield control through gusts and visibility reduction. Air assigns mana to the attack roll only. It carries elemental advantages against Water and Fire and is weakest against Earth and Nature. Elemental interactions: +2 against Water, +1 against Fire, -1 against Nature, -2 against Earth. Air at this rank is a gust and a nudge. The caster can move air with intent and begin shaping where things fly. Default Ability: Light Step (Permanent) Treat every fall as one vertical zone shorter when working out falling damage.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, Air Range: Adjacent zone Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Air dots Effect: A focused gust of air impacts a single target in an adjacent zone. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. Wind with a point to it.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Utility, CC, Air Range: Adjacent zone Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Air dots Effect: A controlled gust of wind pushes a target in an adjacent zone. On 1 success the target is pushed 1 zone in a direction the caster chooses. Defend: Strength + Athletics. Can also be used to push objects or redirect projectiles (Storyteller discretion for non-combat applications). A targeted push of air with real force behind it. The caster can move air across larger distances and begin stripping defenses. Default Ability: Whisper (1 mana, Instant) Send a short spoken message of a sentence or two on the wind to one person within line of sight. Only they hear it.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, Air Range: Targeted Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Air dots Effect: A blade of compressed air launches at a single target within line of sight. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Carries a minor bleed chance: on 3+ excess successes, target gains the Bleeding condition. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. Air made sharp. It cuts.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Reaction Type: Defense, Air Range: Self Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Air dots Effect: When targeted by a ranged projectile or physical ranged attack, spend 2 mana as a Reaction. Roll Dexterity + Magic + Air dots. Each success reduces the incoming attack's success total by 1. If the caster's successes fully meet the attacker's, the attack misses entirely. This does not work against melee attacks or magical targeted spells unless they have a physical projectile component. A wall of moving air that blows an incoming attack off course. The caster can blanket zones in wind and begin using air to enhance their own mobility. Default Ability: Tailwind (Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active) Your movement increases by 1 zone each turn.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE, CC, Air Range: AoE-Cone Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Air dots Effect: A cone of cutting wind erupts from the caster covering all zones directly in front and diagonally forward. Caster rolls once. Each target defends separately. All targets hit are pushed 1 zone directly away from the caster. If a target cannot be pushed (blocked by a wall or barrier), they instead take 1 additional damage. Defend: Strength + Athletics. Everything in front gets blown back.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Utility, Air Range: Self Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Air dots Effect: A burst of wind at the caster's back doubles their movement distance for this turn. This is not flight; the caster must still move along the ground. The effect is immediate and lasts for the turn only. No defend roll required. On 3+ successes, the caster may also choose to move through one zone that would normally cost extra AP (Difficult Terrain, Overgrowth, etc.) without the penalty this turn. The wind pushes from behind. The caster moves faster than they should. The caster can send a straight-line storm and begin to disrupt incoming attacks across the field. Default Ability: Eye of the Wind (Permanent) Your ranged Air spells ignore dice penalties from wind, weather, and non-magical visibility.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, CC, Air Range: Ranged, straight line through any number of zones Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Air dots Effect: A concentrated tornado travels in a straight line from the caster, hitting every target in that line. Caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets. Each target defends separately. Any target hit is Knocked Down (prone). Damage is rolled separately after a successful hit. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. A miniature tornado shot in a line, knocking everyone it touches off their feet.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Defense, Persistent, Air Range: Adjacent zone border Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Air dots Effect: A sustained wall of wind rises along a zone border. All ranged physical attacks and targeted spells attempting to cross the wall must roll vs cast successes as a barrier. If the attack's successes do not exceed the wall successes, the attack is deflected. Any target attempting to cross the border must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or be pushed back 1 zone. Earth Magic reduces cast successes by the Earth caster's successes. Upkeep: 3. A wall of wind that stops things from passing through it. Air can now be used to strip visibility across a whole zone and push multiple targets simultaneously. Default Ability: Updraft Leap (3 mana, Instant) Leap up to 2 vertical zones, or across 2 zones, and land safely.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE, CC, Air Range: Zone Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Air dots Effect: A high-force gale tears through an entire zone. Caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets in the zone. Each target defends separately. All targets hit are pushed 1 zone away from the caster and are Knocked Down. The caster picks the direction for all pushed targets simultaneously. Can hit allies. Defend: Strength + Athletics. A gale strong enough to move everything in a zone at once.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant Type: Utility, Persistent, Air Range: Zone Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Air dots Effect: Dense wind-driven fog fills the zone. All ranged attacks and targeted spells originating from or aimed at targets inside the zone suffer a die penalty equal to cast successes. The penalty applies to everyone equally, allies included. Targets inside the fog cannot be clearly seen from outside. Melee attacks within the zone are unaffected. Upkeep: 4. A fog thick enough that ranged targeting becomes near impossible. Air at this rank can fling targets completely clear of the battlefield or provide the caster with genuine flight. Default Ability: Gale Force (Permanent) Targets your Air spells push or Knock Down are pushed 1 additional zone.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, CC, Air Range: Targeted Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Air dots Effect: A focused vertical updraft hits a single target, launching them into the air. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. The target is Knocked Down and lifted 1 zone directly upward (if indoors or in a covered area, they hit the ceiling and take additional damage equal to excess successes). When they fall back down on their next Upkeep Phase, they take falling damage unless they succeed on Dexterity + Acrobatics vs cast successes. Defend: Strength + Athletics. Up. Involuntarily.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Utility, Persistent, Air Range: Self Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Air dots Effect: The caster achieves sustained flight through magical air manipulation. While active, the caster can move in three dimensions freely. While flying they move at double their normal movement. Taking damage that exceeds their DT while airborne requires Dexterity + Athletics vs the damage dealt. Failure begins a fall, landing on the caster's next Upkeep Phase. Hovering costs half upkeep (3 mana, rounded up). Full flight costs full upkeep. Upkeep: 5. The air carries the caster. They go where they choose. Air at this rank can clear an entire field or create a permanent zone of absolute wind. Default Ability: Storm Crown (Attuned: holds 3 of your M/T while active) Ranged attacks and targeted spells against you lose dice equal to your Air dots.

Mana Cost: 7 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE, CC, Air Range: All zones within line of sight Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Air dots Effect: A massive cyclone fills the entire visible area. Caster rolls once. Every target in every visible zone must defend. Each target defends separately. All targets hit are Knocked Down and pushed 1d10 divided by 2 zones (round up) in a direction the caster picks per target. Targets pushed into barriers take additional damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Strength + Athletics. The caster's zone is affected. The wind takes everyone somewhere else.

Mana Cost: 7 Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Utility, Persistent, Air Range: Zone of caster's choice within line of sight Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Air dots Effect: The caster creates a permanent zone of absolute tempest around a chosen zone, while the chosen zone itself becomes the calm eye. The surrounding zones (all zones adjacent to the eye) become impassable: any target attempting to move through them must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes each attempt, and failure leaves them in the current zone, taking damage equal to excess successes from the wind. All ranged attacks crossing through or originating from the surrounding zones automatically fail. The eye zone is completely calm. Upkeep: 6. A permanent storm with a quiet center. The storm belongs to the caster.

Earth Magic is the school of stone, endurance, and terrain control. Its spells build barriers, reshape the battlefield, and deliver heavy damage. Earth assigns mana to the damage roll only. It carries elemental advantages against Air and Water and is weakest against Nature and Fire. Elemental interactions: +2 against Air, +1 against Water, -1 against Fire, -2 against Nature. Earth at this rank is a stone and a wall. The caster can hurl chunks of rock and raise simple barriers. Default Ability: Stonefoot (Permanent) You gain 1 bonus die on rolls to resist being pushed, pulled, or Knocked Down.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, Earth Range: Adjacent zone Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Earth dots Effect: A stone the size of a fist launches from the ground and strikes a target in an adjacent zone. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. A rock. Thrown with magic. It hits hard.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Reaction Type: Defense, Earth Range: Self Dice Pool: Fortitude + Magic + Earth dots Effect: When an attack is declared against the caster, spend 1 mana as a Reaction to raise a brief earthen barrier. Roll Fortitude + Magic + Earth dots. Each success adds 1 to the caster's DT against this specific attack. The barrier crumbles immediately after blocking. Earth up in front of the caster. Gone after the attack. Earth can be thrown from distance and used to create lasting terrain obstacles. Default Ability: Shape Stone (1 mana, Instant) Reshape a small amount of stone or earth by hand: dig a hole, raise a step, seal a crack, or carve a handhold.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, Earth Range: Targeted Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Earth dots Effect: A rapid barrage of stones launches at a single target within line of sight. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. The sheer volume of stones gives the attack a secondary push: on 3+ excess successes, the target is pushed 1 zone away from the caster. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. Several rocks at once. Still from the ground. Still going where they are aimed.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Utility, Persistent, Earth Range: Zone Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Earth dots Effect: Shattered stone fills the zone, creating difficult terrain. Movement into or through the zone costs 1 additional AP. Any target entering the zone must roll Dexterity + Acrobatics vs cast successes or trip and fall prone (Knocked Down condition). Upkeep: 1. The ground becomes a mess of broken rock. Walking through it is a problem. The caster can raise walls and begin to use earth to bind targets in place. Default Ability: Bedrock (Permanent) Earth Magic defensive spells you cast add 1 more to the DT bonus they grant.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, CC, Earth Range: Targeted Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Earth dots Effect: A spike of stone erupts from the ground directly below a target. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Any target hit must roll Dexterity + Dodge vs cast successes or be pinned: they are Rooted until the spike is broken (Strength + Athletics vs cast successes as an action) or they take 1 damage to wrench free. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. A spike of rock explodes up from beneath a target's feet.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Conjuration, Persistent, Earth Range: Adjacent zone border Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Earth dots Effect: A wall of stone rises along a border between two zones. The wall blocks movement across that border entirely. The wall has a Vitality pool equal to double the cast successes. Attacks that deal at least the wall's current pool value in a single hit bypass the wall. Fire Magic does not damage it. Nature Magic reduces the Vitality pool by the Nature caster's successes over time. Upkeep: 2. Stone rises between two zones and stays there. Earth can now be used to deliver a devastating single-target strike or to build substantial lasting structures. Default Ability: Tremorsense (2 mana, Instant) Until the start of the next Upkeep Phase, you know the location of every creature touching the ground in adjacent zones, even hidden ones.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, CC, Earth Range: Targeted Dice Pool: Dexterity + Magic + Earth dots Effect: A massive boulder conjures from the earth and crashes into a single target. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes plus the caster's Earth dots as a flat bonus. Target must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or be Knocked Down. If the target is already prone, they instead suffer an additional 2 damage from the full impact. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. A very large rock applied to a single target with a great deal of force.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE, CC, Earth Range: Zone (caster's zone) Dice Pool: Strength + Magic + Earth dots Effect: The caster stamps or strikes the ground, sending a tremor through their entire zone. Caster rolls once. Every target in the zone must defend. Each target defends separately. Any target hit is Knocked Down. Damage is rolled separately after a successful hit. The caster is unaffected. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge or Fortitude + Endurance. The ground shakes. Everyone on it goes down. Earth can be used to reshape the ground beneath multiple zones and fortify the caster's body. Default Ability: Living Stone (Attuned: holds 3 of your M/T while active) Your skin hardens like stone. Your BDT increases by 1.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Persistent, Earth Range: Self Dice Pool: Fortitude + Magic + Earth dots Effect: Stone forms beneath and through the caster's skin, dramatically increasing physical resilience. Add cast successes to the caster's BDT against all physical attacks. Additionally, the caster's melee attacks deal additional damage equal to half the cast successes (rounded down) as the stone reinforces their strikes. The caster's movement is reduced by 1 zone while active. Upkeep: 4. The caster becomes partially stone. They are harder to hurt and harder to ignore.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant Type: Attack, AoE, CC, Earth Range: AoE, all zones adjacent to the caster Dice Pool: Intelligence + Magic + Earth dots Effect: The earth shifts violently outward from the caster. Caster rolls once. Every target in any adjacent zone must defend. Each defends separately. All targets hit are Knocked Down.
