Terrana is full of things that want to eat you, test you, recruit you, or sell you something. This chapter gives every creature in the book, and many more, a stat block a Storyteller can run straight from the page. Most entries are short on purpose: a rank, a few numbers, and the two or three things the creature does best. Many of the creatures here are people, not monsters. The Bestial Demonfolk, the monster peoples of Monsera, the Immortal Demon Kings, and the bosses of the Grand Dungeon all have homes, jobs, and opinions. A stat block only says how they fight, not whether they should be fought.
Every creature is built from its rank. Ranks run from F to SSS. At SS and SSS, power jumps: these are threats that only the greatest heroes, or whole armies, can face.

LDT is BDT x2 and ADT is BDT x3, as for characters. Elemental Advantages apply to creatures exactly as they do to spells and conjurations ( Chapter 13 ). Techniques: When an entry says it casts a spell, it uses that spell's full rules from Chapter 13 with the creature's Attack pool. SumMonz: Any beast or wild fiend of rank S or lower can be caught as a SumMonz ( Chapter 13 ). SS and SSS creatures cannot. Loot: Use the creature's rank as its Loot Rank ( Chapter 14 ). SS and SSS creatures drop S rank loot and something unique.

Templates change a creature to fit the story. Stack as many as make sense. Elite: +1 rank. Use the next rank's numbers. Boss: Double every health column, two attacks a turn, and immunity to one condition of the Storyteller's choice. Dungeon bosses already include it. Swarm: Many small bodies as one creature filling a 2x2 area. Area attacks deal +2 damage to it, and it cannot be Rooted or knocked Prone. Pack Alpha: Every pack member in sight adds 1 die to attacks. If the alpha falls, the pack must roll Composure or flee. Elemental: Add one element. The creature gains a rank 2 spell of that school and takes half damage from its own element. Undead: Immune to Poisoned and Bleeding. Takes +2 damage from Bright Magic and Bright-imbued weapons. Voidtouched: Everyone who sees it for the first time makes a Sanity roll, and each of its hits drains 1 or more mana. Dungeon Employee: Respawns in its quarters when defeated. Fights hard, but fights fair, and will not hit a delver who has yielded.

Rank B Beast Large (2x2) Air Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 4 (flying) BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 15 M/T 6 Talons (melee): Slashing damage. Snatch and Drop: On a hit against a Medium or smaller target, carry it up 2 zones and drop it for falling damage. Trait: Flies at double movement. Can be tamed as a mount by a patient rider. Found: Cliffs of the Central Continent, Asura mountains. Loot: Feathers, eggs (worth a Small Gold to a breeder).

Rank B Beast Large (2x2) Nature, Shade Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 15 M/T 6 Tail Volley: Ranged, line of sight. Roll once against up to 3 targets; piercing damage and the Poisoned condition. Maul (melee): Slashing damage. Trait: Speaks a little and enjoys taunting its prey. Found: Begaritt desert, ruins. Loot: Tail spines (B rank arrowheads).

Rank B Beast Large (2x2) Earth, Shade Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 15 M/T 6 Petrifying Gaze: Every enemy who can see it resists with Wisdom + Composure; one that fails is Rooted as its legs turn to stone, and if it fails again next turn it is turned to stone (Petrify, Earth + Nature + Bright + Shade). Bite (melee): Piercing damage. Trait: Looking away or using a mirror gives -2 dice to attack it but immunity to the gaze. Found: Deep caves, the Crystal Mines. Loot: Basilisk eye (A rank artifact material).

Rank B Beast Huge (3x3) Nature Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 11 / 10 / 9 Mana 15 M/T 6 Constrict (melee): Crushing damage; the target is Rooted and takes the Damage pool again each Upkeep until it breaks free with Strength + Athletics. Swallow: A Rooted Medium target at 0 Bashing boxes left is swallowed whole. Trait: Hides in tall grass and trees; first attack each fight gets +3 dice. Found: Demon Continent jungles and rivers. Loot: Snakeskin (B rank armor material).

Rank A Beast Large (2x2) Fire, Nature, Air Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 10 / 9 / 8 Mana 18 M/T 7 Three Heads: Three attacks a turn: lion bite (piercing), goat horns (kinetic), serpent tail (piercing and Poisoned). Fire Breath: Casts Fireball (Fire Rank 5) once per scene. Trait: Each head can be targeted separately (one third of its boxes each); losing a head loses that attack. Found: Fighting pits, the Ironwood Colosseum, Demon Continent wilds. Loot: Chimera heart (A rank alchemy).

Rank S Beast Gargantuan (4x4) Earth Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 12 / LDT 24 / ADT 36 Health 15 / 14 / 13 Mana 21 M/T 8 Trample: Moves up to 3 zones; everything in its path defends or takes kinetic damage and is knocked Prone. Tremor Roar: Casts Earthquake (Earth Rank 5). Horn Gore (melee): Kinetic damage, +3 dice against structures. Trait: Fills a 4x4 area. Town Rapan is built inside the ribs of one. Found: Deep in the Demon Continent; one every few generations. Loot: Bones for a town, hide for an army.
Most plants stay still. These do not.

Rank E Plant Small Nature Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 1 BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Scream: Every creature in adjacent zones resists with Composure + Endurance; those who fail lose their next action. Trait: Pulling it from the ground triggers the scream automatically. Found: Old gardens, witches' plots. Loot: Mandrake root (alchemy, worth a Small Silver).

Rank E Fungus Medium Nature Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 1 BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Spore Burst: Casts the Nature Rank 2 spell. Club (melee): Kinetic damage. Trait: Myconids talk with spores; anyone caught in a cloud hears their thoughts as a buzzing. Found: The Fungal Grotto. Loot: Glowcap mushrooms.

Rank D Plant Large (2x2) Nature Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 7 / 6 / 5 Mana 9 M/T 4 Vine Whip: Casts the Nature Rank 2 spell. Digest: A Rooted target takes acid damage each Upkeep. Trait: Looks like a normal hedge until it moves. Found: Canopy Wilds, Milis forests. Loot: Sap (alchemy).

Rank C Plant Large (2x2) Nature, Earth Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 12 M/T 5 Branch Slam (melee): Kinetic damage and the target is knocked back one zone. Entangle: Casts the Nature Rank 1 spell on everyone in adjacent zones. Trait: Takes double damage from Fire attacks. Many are old enough to talk, slowly. Found: Old forests on every continent. Loot: Living wood (B rank staff material).

Rank B Fungus Huge (3x3) Nature, Shade Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 11 / 10 / 9 Mana 15 M/T 6 Spore Cloud: Casts Miasma Bloom (Air + Nature + Shade). Spawn: Once per turn, a Myconid Scout grows from the floor in an adjacent zone. Trait: Rooted in place. Burning it ends the spawning. Found: Heart of the Fungal Grotto. Loot: Mother spore (A rank alchemy).

The Bestials are people, the largest population on the Demon Continent and equal citizens there ( Chapter 8 ). Orcs are pigfolk, kobolds are dogfolk, lizardmen are scaled, and the bugfolk build hives. These entries describe warriors, raiders, and guards, the ones a party is most likely to cross swords with.

Rank F Bestial Demonfolk Small None Attack 4 Defense 4 Damage 3 Move 1 BDT 3 / LDT 6 / ADT 9 Health 3 / 2 / 1 Mana 3 M/T 2 Spear (melee): Piercing damage. Scent Track: Adds 3 dice to Awareness rolls to track by smell. Trait: Kobolds are canine and loyal to their pack; a scout that spots a party runs to fetch the rest. Found: Demon Continent hills and mines, the Upper Halls. Loot: Coins, a small blade.

Rank D Bestial Demonfolk Medium None Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 5 / 4 / 3 Mana 9 M/T 4 Rally Bark: Allies who hear it add 1 die to attacks this turn. Glaive (melee, Reach): Slashing damage. Trait: Leads 4 to 6 Kobold Scouts. Found: Demon Continent. Loot: D rank weapon.

Rank E Bestial Demonfolk Medium None Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 1 BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Great Cleaver (melee): Slashing damage. Tusk Charge: Move 2 zones in a line and attack with +1 die. Trait: Orcs are pigfolk: hearty, loud, and fond of a good meal and a good fight. Most serve Raja Iblis Baglahagla. Found: Northwest Demon Continent, mercenary companies. Loot: E rank weapon, rations.

Rank D Bestial Demonfolk Medium Earth, Fire Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 5 / 4 / 3 Mana 9 M/T 4 Stone Spike: Casts the Earth Rank 3 spell. War Chant: Allies in sight add 1 die to damage this turn. Trait: Usually travels with a band of Orc Warriors. Found: Orc domains. Loot: Bone charms, a D rank focus.

Rank B Bestial Demonfolk Large (2x2) Earth Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 15 M/T 6 Greataxe (melee): Slashing damage; two attacks a turn. Iron Body: Casts the Battle Aura Rank 2 spell. Trait: Commands a war band of 10 or more. Respects anyone who beats them in a fair duel. Found: Orc domains. Loot: B rank weapon, war banner.

Rank D Bestial Demonfolk Medium Water Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 5 / 4 / 3 Mana 9 M/T 4 Spear and Shield (melee): Piercing damage. Tail Sweep: Every enemy in adjacent zones defends or is knocked Prone. Trait: Swims as well as it walks. Slows in the cold (-1 die). Found: Demon Continent marshes, rivers. Loot: Scale shield.

Rank C Bestial Demonfolk Medium Water, Nature Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Venom: Casts Venom (Water + Shade). Quagmire: Casts Quagmire (Water + Earth). Trait: Keeper of the tribe's old songs. Found: Marsh villages. Loot: Shaman staff (C rank focus: Water).

Rank E Bestial Demonfolk Medium Earth Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 1 BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Mandibles (melee): Slashing damage. Hive Signal: Every drone within 3 zones knows where the drone's target is. Trait: Ant-like workers and soldiers. They fight as one. Found: Hive mounds in the Demon Continent. Loot: Chitin.

Rank C Bestial Demonfolk Medium Air Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Twin Scythes (melee): Slashing damage; two attacks a turn. Leap: Moves 3 zones in a single jump. Trait: Duelists of the bugfolk. Bow before attacking. Found: Hives, mercenary companies. Loot: Mantis blades (C rank short blades).

Rank A Bestial Demonfolk Huge (3x3) Earth, Nature Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 10 / LDT 20 / ADT 30 Health 12 / 11 / 10 Mana 18 M/T 7 Brood Call: Once per turn, 2 Bugfolk Drones arrive in adjacent zones. Acid Spray: Ranged, line of sight. Roll once against up to 3 targets; acid damage. Hive Mind: All bugfolk in sight add 1 die to every roll. Trait: Never leaves the hive. The drones fight to the last for her. Found: The heart of a hive. Loot: Royal jelly (A rank alchemy, worth a Large Gold).
The monster peoples of Monsera and the Shaded Isles ( Chapter 8 ) are citizens, neighbors, and very often dungeon employees. These stat blocks cover the ones a party meets with weapons drawn.

Rank F Gremlinesque Small None Attack 4 Defense 4 Damage 3 Move 1 BDT 3 / LDT 6 / ADT 9 Health 3 / 2 / 1 Mana 3 M/T 2 Shiv (melee): Piercing damage. Dirty Trick: Throws sand or a gadget: the target suffers -2 dice on its next roll. Trait: Clever, quick, and fond of anything with moving parts. Found: The Upper Halls, Monsera workshops. Loot: Gadget scraps, coins.

Rank E Gremlinesque Small Fire Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 1 BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Boom Jar: Thrown, up to double Strength in zones. Burning damage to everyone in the target zone. Turret: Once per scene, places a clockwork crossbow that attacks each turn with its Attack pool. Trait: Never fights fair and never apologizes. Found: Workshops, the Gearworks. Loot: Clockwork parts, an implement.

Rank C Ogre Large (2x2) None Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 12 M/T 5 Club (melee): Kinetic damage and the target is knocked back one zone. Grab and Throw: On a hit against a Medium or smaller target, throw it 2 zones. Trait: Ogres left the Demon Continent long ago because they prefer peace. Calm and gentle until a friend is hurt. Found: The Ogre Islands, Monsera. Loot: C rank club.

Rank C Brute Large (2x2) Earth Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 12 M/T 5 Claws (melee): Slashing damage; two attacks a turn. Regenerate: Neutralizes 2 Bashing each Upkeep unless it took burning or acid damage since its last turn. Trait: Hard to kill and easy to anger. Found: Bridges, mountains, the Upper Halls. Loot: Troll blood (regeneration potion ingredient).

Rank B Brute Large (2x2) Earth Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 15 M/T 6 Greataxe (melee): Slashing damage. Bull Rush: Move 3 zones in a line; everything in the way defends or is knocked Prone. Trait: Never lost in a maze; always knows the way to its target. Found: Labyrinths, Monsera's infrastructure division. Loot: B rank axe.
Built things: golems shaped from earth and mana, and automatons made by the Makers Guild and older, stranger hands. None of them feel fear, pain, or the Void's horror.

Rank E Construct Medium None Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 1 BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Tool Arm (melee): Kinetic damage. Repair: Neutralizes 1 Bashing on another construct in an adjacent zone. Trait: Household and factory automatons. Most are harmless unless their orders change. Found: Monsera homes, factories, the Gearworks. Loot: Clockwork core (implement part).

Rank D Construct Medium Shade Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 5 / 4 / 3 Mana 9 M/T 4 Sword (melee): Slashing damage. Empty Shell: Hits that strike a gap (excess successes of 3 or more) only deal half damage. Trait: A suit of armor animated by a lingering will. Found: Castles, the Catacombs. Loot: D rank armor.

Rank D Construct Large (2x2) Earth, Water Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 7 / 6 / 5 Mana 9 M/T 4 Mud Slam (melee): Kinetic damage and the target is Rooted until the end of its next turn. Trait: Reforms after being destroyed unless its core is removed. Found: Swamps, the work sites of earth mages. Loot: Golem core (Small Mana Crystal).

Rank C Construct Medium Earth Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Halberd (melee, Reach): Slashing damage. Alarm: Every construct on the floor knows where intruders are. Trait: Guards one door forever. Found: Vaults, the Gearworks. Loot: Gears, a C rank halberd.

Rank C Construct Medium Air Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Rapier (melee): Piercing damage; two attacks a turn. Learned Style: Copies the Combat Style of the last enemy that hit it, adding 1 die to its attacks. Trait: Built for sport. Some have fought thousands of bouts. Found: Nite City arenas, noble estates. Loot: Duelist core (C rank).

Rank C Construct Large (2x2) Earth Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 12 M/T 5 Stone Fist (melee): Kinetic damage. Stoneskin: Casts the Earth Rank 5 spell on itself once per fight. Trait: Slow and relentless. Movement 1. Found: Ruins, temples. Loot: Golem core (Mana Crystal).

Rank B Construct Large (2x2) Earth, Fire Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 15 M/T 6 Iron Fist (melee): Kinetic damage; two attacks a turn. Furnace Vent: Every creature in adjacent zones takes burning damage equal to its Damage pool. Trait: Immune to Poisoned and Chilled. Found: Dwarven halls, the Forge Depths. Loot: Iron golem core (Large Mana Crystal).

Rank B Construct Huge (3x3) Fire, Earth Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 11 / 10 / 9 Mana 15 M/T 6 Cannon Arm: Ranged, line of sight. Kinetic damage to the target zone and adjacent zones. Stomp (melee): Kinetic damage and knocked Prone. Trait: Built for the God Wars or the Kaiju lines. Some still wander with old orders. Found: Battlefields, the Old Rail Tunnels. Loot: War core (A rank implement part).

Rank A Construct Large (2x2) Varies Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 10 / 9 / 8 Mana 18 M/T 7 Spell Absorption: When a spell hits it, roll its Defense; each success cancels 1 damage and gives it 1 mana. Discharge: Spends stored mana to cast any single-school spell of rank 5 or lower that hit it this fight. Trait: Built by the Mages Guild to test, and to punish, spellcasters. Found: Mages Guild vaults, the Arcane Laboratories. Loot: Construct heart (A rank artifact material).

When a body's mana runs out and it was never cremated, it can rise as mindless undead ( Chapter 13 ). Sentient undead are rarer and far more dangerous. All undead are hurt by Bright Magic and helped by Shade.

Rank F Undead Medium Shade Attack 4 Defense 4 Damage 3 Move 1 BDT 3 / LDT 6 / ADT 9 Health 3 / 2 / 1 Mana 3 M/T 2 Rusty Blade (melee): Slashing damage. Trait: Takes half damage from piercing attacks, rounded down. Found: Catacombs, battlefields. Loot: Bones, rusty gear.

Rank F Undead Medium Shade Attack 4 Defense 4 Damage 3 Move 1 BDT 3 / LDT 6 / ADT 9 Health 3 / 2 / 1 Mana 3 M/T 2 Grab and Bite (melee): Piercing damage, and the target is Rooted until it beats the zombie's attack with Strength + Athletics. Trait: Keeps coming. Stands back up once unless its head is destroyed. Found: Graveyards, plague towns. Loot: None worth keeping.

Rank E Undead Medium Shade Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 2 BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Claws (melee): Slashing damage; the target resists with Fortitude + Endurance or loses its next action to paralysis. Trait: Eats the dead. Fast and clever. Found: Catacombs, old battlefields. Loot: Ghoul nails (alchemy).

Rank D Undead Medium Shade Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 5 / 4 / 3 Mana 9 M/T 4 Chilling Touch (melee): Cold damage; ignores Armor. Haunt: Forces a Sanity roll on everyone who sees it for the first time. Trait: Incorporeal: nothing physical touches it except magic, silver, and Bright-imbued weapons ( Chapter 8 ). Found: Haunted houses, Funayurei waters, the Catacombs. Loot: Ectoplasm (alchemy).

Rank C Undead Medium Shade Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Mana Drain: Casts Mass Drain (Shade Rank 5) once per scene. Soul Touch (melee): Cold damage; ignores Armor. Trait: Incorporeal. Feeds on mana. Found: Ruins, the Thinning Halls. Loot: Wraith essence (B rank Shade focus material).

Rank B Undead Large (2x2) Shade Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 15 M/T 6 Headless Charge: Rides 3 zones and attacks. Slashing damage. Wail: Everyone who hears it makes a Sanity roll. Trait: A headless knight on a headless horse. It carries its head and sees through its eyes. Found: The Shaded Isles, haunted roads. Loot: Black armor (B rank).

Rank A Undead Medium Shade Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 18 M/T 7 Cursed Sword (melee): Slashing damage; two attacks a turn. Shadowflame: Casts Shadowflame (Fire + Shade). Command Dead: Undead in sight add 2 dice to attacks. Trait: A fallen knight raised with its skill intact. Found: Fallen castles, the Silent Necropolis. Loot: A rank sword, often cursed.

Rank C Undead (Vampire) Medium Shade Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Bite (melee): Piercing damage; on a hit it drinks, gaining 1 mana and neutralizing 1 Bashing. Blood Bolt: Casts the Blood Sorcery Rank 3 power ( Chapter 8 ). Blur: Casts the Celerity Rank 2 power. Trait: Vampires are a heritage ( Chapter 8 ), and most are citizens like anyone else. This entry is for the ones who hunt. Each has a Compulsion tied to one of its scales. Found: Cities at night, old manors, the Shaded Isles. Loot: Whatever its victims carried.

Rank A Undead (Vampire) Medium Shade Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 18 M/T 7 Hemorrhage: Casts the Blood Sorcery Rank 6 power. Command: A Dominion power: one target in sight resists with Wisdom + Composure or obeys a simple order on its turn. Second Strike: Casts the Celerity Rank 4 power; two attacks a turn. Trait: An old vampire with a house of lesser vampires and human servants. Rarely fights its own battles until it has to. Found: Noble manors, the Shaded Isles. Loot: An A rank heirloom, a house's secrets.

Rank S Undead (Vampire) Medium Shade, Water Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 21 M/T 8 Crimson Tide: Casts the Blood Sorcery Rank 7 power. Exsanguinate: Casts the Blood Sorcery Rank 7 power on one target. Dominion of the Court: Every vampire in sight adds 2 dice to every roll, and every enemy resists with Wisdom + Composure or loses its next action. Undying: Neutralizes 2 Bashing and 1 Lethal each Upkeep while she has mana. Trait: The ruler of a vampire court, often centuries old. Her compulsion is the only weakness most of her enemies ever find. Found: The deepest courts of the Shaded Isles. Loot: An S rank artifact and a court's worth of debts.

Rank S Undead Medium Shade, Water Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 21 M/T 8 Black Pulse: Casts the Shade Rank 6 spell. Animate Dead: Casts the Shade Rank 5 spell. Black Blizzard: Casts Black Blizzard (Fire + Water + Air + Shade) once per scene. Trait: Its soul is bound to a phylactery. Destroy the phylactery or it returns in a month. Found: Hidden towers, the deepest catacombs. Loot: Phylactery, spellbooks, S rank focus.

Rank S Undead Huge (3x3) Shade Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 3 (flying) BDT 11 / LDT 22 / ADT 33 Health 13 / 12 / 11 Mana 21 M/T 8 Deathbreath: Ranged, a cone 3 zones long. Cold damage and everyone hit makes a Sanity roll. Claws and Tail: Two melee attacks a turn; slashing damage. Trait: A dragon raised by a lich. Flies at double movement, if its wings still hold. Found: Dragon graveyards, a lich's lair. Loot: Dragon bone (S rank weapon material).
Dragonkind ranges from beasts that think about little but food and territory to Ancient Dragons who are older than nations and every bit as clever as the people who fear them.

Rank C Dragon Large (2x2) Fire Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 2 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 12 M/T 5 Fire Breath: Casts the Fire Rank 3 spell. Bite (melee): Piercing damage. Trait: Wingless and quick. Immune to Burning. Found: Volcanic Fields, Red Wyrm foothills. Loot: Drake scales (C rank armor).

Rank C Dragon Large (2x2) Water, Air Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 2 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 12 M/T 5 Frost Breath: Casts Frost Lance (Water Rank 3) as a cone 2 zones long; everyone hit is Chilled. Bite (melee): Piercing damage. Trait: Wingless and sure-footed on ice. Immune to Chilled. Found: Snowfields, northern mountains, frozen caves. Loot: Drake scales (C rank armor).

Rank C Dragon Large (2x2) Air, Nature Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 4 (flying) BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 12 M/T 5 Tail Stinger: Piercing damage and the Poisoned condition. Dive: Moves 4 zones and attacks with +2 dice. Trait: Two legs, two wings, a bad temper. Flies at double movement. Found: Cliffs and peaks everywhere. Loot: Wyvern venom, hide.

Rank B Dragon Huge (3x3) Earth Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 11 / 10 / 9 Mana 15 M/T 6 Burrow: Moves through earth and stone as if it were air, 2 zones per turn, and bursts out under a target with +3 dice. Crushing Bite (melee): Crushing damage. Rock Barrage: Casts the Earth Rank 2 spell at everyone in adjacent zones. Trait: Wingless, enormous, and found in deep valleys where they lie still for years. Gives off tremors before it attacks. Found: Earth Dragon valleys of the Central Continent. Loot: Earth dragon scale (A rank armor material).

Rank A Dragon Large (2x2) Fire, Air Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 4 (flying) BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 10 / 9 / 8 Mana 18 M/T 7 Flame Breath: Casts Rain of Fire (Fire Rank 6). Claws (melee): Slashing damage; two attacks a turn. Flock: Red Wyrms hunt in groups; each adjacent wyrm adds 1 die to the others' attacks. Trait: Flies at double movement. The Red Wyrm Mountains are home to hundreds, and the passes are only safe in large caravans. Found: The Red Wyrm Mountains. Loot: Red wyrm scale (A rank), wyrm heart (S rank alchemy).

Rank A Dragon Large (2x2) Water, Air Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 4 (flying) BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 10 / 9 / 8 Mana 18 M/T 7 Frost Breath: Casts Blizzard (Water Rank 6). Tail Lash (melee): Kinetic damage, knocked back 2 zones. Trait: Swims as well as it flies. Lives on cold coasts and sea cliffs. Found: Northern coasts, the Ringus Sea. Loot: Blue scale (A rank), frost gland.

Rank A Dragon Large (2x2) Air, Fire Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 4 (flying) BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 10 / 9 / 8 Mana 18 M/T 7 Lightning Breath: Casts Plasma (Fire + Air) as a line 4 zones long. Wing Gale: Casts Shearing Gale (Air Rank 5). Trait: Rides the edge of thunderstorms. Found: High peaks, storm seas. Loot: Storm scale (A rank).

Rank S Dragon Huge (3x3) Shade, Fire Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 4 (flying) BDT 11 / LDT 22 / ADT 33 Health 13 / 12 / 11 Mana 21 M/T 8 Shadowflame Breath: Casts Convergent Flame (Fire + Bright + Shade) as darkfire, or Shadowflame (Fire + Shade) as a cone. Claws (melee): Slashing damage; two attacks a turn. Dread Aura: Enemies within 2 zones make a Sanity roll at the start of the fight. Trait: A dark dragon is often seen flying over Gaslow, Atoferatofe's domain. Whether it serves her or simply likes the bog is a matter of debate. Found: Gaslow, the eastern Demon Continent. Loot: Dark scale (S rank).

Rank S Dragon Huge (3x3) Any two Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 4 (flying) BDT 11 / LDT 22 / ADT 33 Health 13 / 12 / 11 Mana 21 M/T 8 Breath: Casts any rank 7 spell of either of its elements. Claws, Wings, Tail: Three attacks a turn: slashing, kinetic, kinetic. Scales: Takes half damage from spells, rounded down. Trait: Old, clever, and greedy. Most can speak and some will bargain. Found: Remote mountains and islands. Loot: A hoard. Scales worth a fortune.

Rank SS Dragon (sentient) Gargantuan (4x4) Any three Attack 20 Defense 20 Damage 12 Move 5 (flying) BDT 15 / LDT 30 / ADT 45 Health 18 / 17 / 16 Mana 30 M/T 12 Sovereign Breath: Casts a five-school combination spell made of its elements, such as Primordial Storm. Claws, Wings, Tail, Bite: Four attacks a turn. Ancient Scales: Takes half damage from spells, rounded down. Trait: Ancient Dragons are not beasts. They are people with their own goals, kingdoms, and grudges, as old as nations. Fighting one is a story arc, not an encounter. Vaelthrax, the Slime King's companion, is the most famous. Found: Wherever they choose. Loot: Whatever they allow you to take.
Not everything in the water is the size of an island. Rivers and coasts hold smaller dangers, and the open sea holds the largest.

Rank E Aquatic Small Water Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 1 BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Grasping Fingers (melee): Kinetic damage; the target is pulled one zone deeper into the water. Trait: Pale lake goblins with long, strong fingers. They drag swimmers down in groups. Found: Lakes, ponds, the Flooded Caverns. Loot: None.

Rank D Aquatic Medium Water Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 5 / 4 / 3 Mana 9 M/T 4 Sumo Grapple (melee): Kinetic damage and the target is knocked Prone. Water Jet: Casts the Water Rank 2 spell. Trait: Turtle-shelled river folk with a water-filled dish on their heads. Bowing politely makes them bow back, spilling the water: they lose all their dice until they refill it. They love cucumbers and keep their promises. Found: Rivers and ponds of the eastern isles. Loot: Kappa medicine (heals as Basic healing, PHP 2).

Rank D Undead, Aquatic Medium Water, Shade Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 5 / 4 / 3 Mana 9 M/T 4 Ladle: Fills a boat with water: each use, the boat takes kinetic damage to its Hull. Drowning Grip (melee): Cold damage; ignores Armor. Trait: Ghosts of drowned sailors. Giving them a ladle with no bottom keeps them busy until dawn. Found: Foggy seas at night. Loot: Ectoplasm.

Rank D Aquatic Medium Water Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 5 / 4 / 3 Mana 9 M/T 4 Trident (melee): Piercing damage. Ink Cloud: Casts Mist (Fire + Water) as an ink cloud underwater. Trait: Fish-headed raiders from the dark water. Not to be confused with Fishfolk citizens ( Chapter 8 ), who resent the comparison. Found: Reefs, sunken ships. Loot: Pearls, coral knives.

Rank D Aquatic Large (2x2) Water, Earth Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 7 / 6 / 5 Mana 9 M/T 4 Pincers (melee): Crushing damage; the target is Rooted until it breaks free. Trait: Its shell gives +2 BDT against attacks from the front. Found: Beaches and tidepools. Loot: Crab meat, shell (D rank shield material).

Rank C Aquatic Large (2x2) Water Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 3 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 12 M/T 5 Enchanting Mane: Anyone who touches it is stuck fast and is dragged into deep water on its next turn. Water Jet: Casts the Water Rank 2 spell. Hooves (melee): Kinetic damage. Trait: A water horse that looks like a lost pony. A bridle made with its true name tames it. Found: Lochs, rivers, lakes. Loot: Kelpie hair (C rank focus material: Water).

Rank C Aquatic Medium Water, Air Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Song: Everyone who hears it resists with Composure + Insight or must move one zone toward her on their turn. Claws (melee): Slashing damage. Trait: Covering your ears gives -2 dice to Awareness but immunity to the song. Found: Rocky coasts, the Tide Ruins. Loot: Siren scale.

Rank B Aquatic Huge (3x3) Water Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 11 / 10 / 9 Mana 15 M/T 6 Coil (melee): Crushing damage to a ship's Hull or a creature. Tidal Pull: Casts the Water Rank 5 spell. Trait: Can wrap a corvette and drag it under. Found: Open seas. Loot: Serpent scales (B rank).

Rank A Aquatic, Spirit Huge (3x3) Water, Shade Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 10 / LDT 20 / ADT 30 Health 12 / 11 / 10 Mana 18 M/T 7 Rising Dark: Appears beside a ship in calm water; the crew makes a Sanity roll. Swamp the Deck: Casts Deluge (Water Rank 7) on a ship. Demand: Asks for a barrel. Giving it a barrel with no bottom ends the encounter. Trait: A vast black shape with pale eyes that rises out of a calm sea. Rarely fought, often survived by good manners. Found: Calm seas at night. Loot: None.

Rank A Aquatic Gargantuan (4x4) Water Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 11 / LDT 22 / ADT 33 Health 14 / 13 / 12 Mana 18 M/T 7 Tentacles: Four attacks a turn against creatures or a ship's Hull; crushing damage. Ink: Casts Mist (Fire + Water); everyone in it is blinded. Trait: Each tentacle has its own boxes (a quarter of the total); cut one off and it loses an attack. Found: Deep ocean, the Coral Throne. Loot: Kraken ink (A rank alchemy).

Rank SS Sea Monster Gargantuan (4x4) Water Attack 20 Defense 20 Damage 12 Move 1 BDT 15 / LDT 30 / ADT 45 Health 18 / 17 / 16 Mana 30 M/T 12 Drowned World: Casts Drowned World (Water + Air + Earth + Nature + Shade). Swallow Ship: Swallows a ship up to frigate size. Whirlpool: Every ship within 6 zones is pulled 2 zones toward it each turn. Trait: A creature from the oldest stories. It has been seen twice in recorded history. Found: The deepest ocean. Loot: Legend.

s: Fey of the Dreeming and the Seeming
t: Fey come from the two halves of the Void World where belief takes shape ( Chapter 1 ). Dreeming fey lean toward play and protection; Seeming fey lean toward fear and harm.

Rank E Fey (Dreeming) Tiny Air, Nature Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 3 (flying) BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Pixie Dust: Casts Decrease Weight (Air + Bright + Shade) on an ally, or a prank: the target suffers -2 dice on its next roll. Glamour: Becomes invisible until it attacks. Trait: Tiny, playful, and easily offended. Flies at double movement. Found: Flower meadows, the Dreeming. Loot: Pixie dust (alchemy).

Rank E Fey (Dreeming) Tiny Bright Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 2 (flying) BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Lure: Anyone following it resists with Wisdom + Insight or follows it off the path. Trait: Leads lost travelers somewhere, not always where they meant to go. Found: Bogs, foggy roads. Loot: Wisp light (Glow implement part).

Rank C Fey (Dreeming) Large (2x2) Nature, Bright Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 3 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 12 M/T 5 Antler Charge: Move 3 zones and attack; kinetic damage. Mending Bloom: Casts Mending Bloom (Nature + Bright) on a creature it trusts. Trait: A white stag that appears to people who need a reason to keep going. Found: Old forests, the Dreeming. Loot: Never taken; it gives a blessing instead.

Rank C Fey (Dreeming) Medium Fire, Bright Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Foxfire: Casts Radiant Flame (Fire + Bright). Illusion: Casts Mirror Mist (Water + Air + Bright + Shade) once per scene. Trait: A fox spirit with more than one tail. Loves riddles, fried tofu, and embarrassing the proud. Found: Shrines, the eastern isles, the Dreeming. Loot: A tail-hair charm (C rank Fire focus).

Rank E Fey (Seeming) Small Shade Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 2 (flying) BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Nightmare Bite (melee): Piercing damage; the target makes a Sanity roll. Vanish: Becomes invisible in darkness. Trait: Rides sleepers' chests and feeds on their fear. Found: Bedrooms, the Seeming. Loot: Nightmare dust.

Rank D Fey (Seeming) Small Shade, Earth Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 5 / 4 / 3 Mana 9 M/T 4 Pike (melee, Reach): Piercing damage. Every hit reddens its cap and adds 1 die to its next attack. Iron Boots: Cannot be knocked Prone or moved. Trait: Murderous goblin-like fey. Reading scripture aloud, or a cross of iron, makes it flee. Found: Ruined towers, the Seeming. Loot: Bloodied cap (cursed).

Rank B Fey (Seeming) Medium Shade Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 7 / 6 / 5 Mana 15 M/T 6 From the Dark: Steps from any shadow to any other shadow in sight. Terror: Casts Fog of Dread (Shade Rank 3); everyone in it makes a Sanity roll. Claws (melee): Slashing damage. Trait: Made from every child's fear of the closet. Bright light hurts it: +2 dice to attacks against it in a lit zone. Found: Under beds, closets, the Seeming. Loot: None.

Rank A Fey (Seeming) Medium Shade, Nature Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 18 M/T 7 Curse: Casts Cursed Roots (Earth + Nature + Shade). Bargain: Offers a deal; refusing costs nothing, accepting always costs more than it seems. Plague Fog: Casts Plague Fog (Water + Air + Nature + Shade) once per scene. Trait: Hags trade in names, years, and memories. Found: Swamp cottages, crossroads, the Seeming. Loot: A bargained item, always cursed.
Voidlings feed on mana, and their existence is hostile to the ordered mind ( Chapter 11 ). Every Void creature forces Sanity rolls; Sanity dots are the pool to resist them.

Rank E Void, Swarm Large (2x2) Shade Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 6 M/T 3 Feed: Every creature in adjacent zones loses 1 mana; one with no mana takes cold damage instead. Trait: A swarm of small, wrong shapes. Area attacks deal +2 damage to it. Found: Near Void openings, Nyxhollow. Loot: Void dust (dangerous alchemy).

Rank C Void Medium Shade Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Phase Strike: Teleports up to 3 zones and attacks; slashing damage that ignores Armor. Mana Hunger: Adds 2 dice to attacks against whoever has the most mana. Trait: Seeing one for the first time forces a Sanity roll. Found: Void openings, the Thinning Halls. Loot: Void shard (A rank artifact material).

Rank B Void Large (2x2) Shade Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 15 M/T 6 Devour (melee): Piercing damage; the target loses mana equal to the damage boxes it marks. Pull: Every creature within 3 zones is pulled one zone toward it each Upkeep. Trait: A mouth with nothing behind it. Found: Void openings. Loot: Void core.

Rank A Void Huge (3x3) Shade Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 10 / LDT 20 / ADT 30 Health 12 / 11 / 10 Mana 18 M/T 7 Unmake: Casts Soul Drain (Shade Rank 7). Tendrils: Three attacks a turn; cold damage. Wrongness: Everyone in sight makes a Sanity roll each turn. Trait: What comes through when a Void opening tears wide. Found: Major Void breaches. Loot: Void heart (S rank, cursed).

Rank S Void, Kaiju Gargantuan (4x4) Shade, Water Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 12 / LDT 24 / ADT 36 Health 15 / 14 / 13 Mana 21 M/T 8 Black Tide: Casts Black Blizzard (Fire + Water + Air + Shade) as a wave. Swallow Mana: Every creature in sight loses mana equal to the Leviathan's rank each turn. Trait: A Void creature large enough to swim between worlds. Found: The Outer Dark, deep Void breaches. Loot: Legend.

Rank S Void, Kaiju Gargantuan (4x4) Shade, Water, Earth Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 12 / LDT 24 / ADT 36 Health 15 / 14 / 13 Mana 21 M/T 8 Tidal Smash: Casts Monsoon (Water + Air + Earth + Nature). Stomp and Crush: Two attacks a turn against everything in a 2x2 area; kinetic damage. Armored Hide: Takes half damage from anything without Armor or Magic Penetration. Wrongness: Everyone who sees it makes a Sanity roll. Trait: The smallest of the Kaiju, and still an S rank threat. About once a year one breaks out of the Rift at the center of the Ringus Sea, and the HRC and the Titans meet it before it reaches a shore ( Chapter 3 ). Found: The Rift in the Ringus Sea, other Void breaches. Loot: A Kaiju core: worth a King's Gold to the right buyer.

Rank SSS Void, Kaiju Colossal (5x5) Shade, any Attack 25 Defense 25 Damage 15 Move 1 BDT 19 / LDT 38 / ADT 57 Health 23 / 22 / 21 Mana 45 M/T 15 Nightfall: Casts Nightfall (Fire + Water + Air + Earth + Nature + Shade). Crush: Four attacks a turn against everything in a 5x5 area. Wrongness: Everyone within sight makes a Sanity roll every turn, at -2 dice. Endless: Takes half damage from everything that is not a combination spell or an S rank weapon. Trait: The worst thing the Void has ever sent. Nations, the HRC, and the Titans together have stopped one only twice. Found: Catastrophic Void breaches. Loot: A continent's worth of salvage, if anything survives.
Not every threat is a monster. These cover the people a party is likely to face: from street thugs to the strongest swordsmen alive. Add a heritage's Innate Attribute and Heritage Merit for flavor.

Rank F Person Medium None Attack 4 Defense 4 Damage 3 Move 1 BDT 3 / LDT 6 / ADT 9 Health 3 / 2 / 1 Mana 3 M/T 2 Short Sword (melee): Slashing damage. Crossbow: Ranged, line of sight. Piercing damage, Reload (1). Trait: Runs when half the gang is down. Found: Roads, Breakwater alleys. Loot: A few coins.

Rank E Person Medium None Attack 6 Defense 6 Damage 4 Move 1 BDT 4 / LDT 8 / ADT 12 Health 4 / 3 / 2 Mana 6 M/T 3 Club (melee): Kinetic damage. Gang Up: +2 dice when another thug is adjacent to the target. Trait: Usually works for someone worse. Found: Nite City back streets. Loot: Coins, a debt ledger.

Rank D Person Medium None Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 5 / 4 / 3 Mana 9 M/T 4 Spear (melee, Reach): Piercing damage. Whistle: Calls 1d10 more guards over the next 3 turns. Trait: Would rather arrest you than kill you. Found: Every city. Loot: D rank spear, a badge.

Rank D Person Medium None Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 5 / 4 / 3 Mana 9 M/T 4 Weapon (melee or ranged): Damage by weapon type. Professional: Retreats if the pay stops being worth it. Trait: Members of the Mercenaries Guild in space, or freelancers on Terrana. Found: Everywhere money is. Loot: D rank weapon, a contract.

Rank C Person Medium Any one Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Signature Weapon (melee): Damage by weapon type, two attacks a turn. School Spell: Casts one rank 3 spell of its school. Trait: Has been to the fortieth floor and has the scars. Found: The Grand Dungeon, guild halls. Loot: C rank gear.

Rank C Person Medium None Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Longsword (melee): Slashing damage. Shield Wall: Allies in adjacent zones add 1 to BDT. Trait: Sworn to a house or a crown. Found: Noble estates, Asura, Milishion. Loot: C rank armor and sword.

Rank C Person Medium Any two Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Bolt: Casts a rank 2 spell of either school. Combination: Casts a two-school combination spell of its schools once per scene. Trait: Usually trained at Monsera University. Found: Guilds, armies, universities. Loot: C rank focus.

Rank B Person Medium Shade Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 7 / 6 / 5 Mana 15 M/T 6 Poisoned Blade (melee): Piercing damage and the Poisoned condition; +3 dice against a target that has not acted yet this fight. Shadow Step: Casts the Shade Rank 4 spell. Trait: Works for the Shaded Isles, a noble house, or the highest bidder. Found: Anywhere. Loot: B rank daggers, poisons.

Rank B Person Medium Shade Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 7 / 6 / 5 Mana 15 M/T 6 Animate Dead: Casts the Shade Rank 5 spell. Corruption Bolt: Casts the Shade Rank 2 spell. Trait: Rarely alone: usually surrounded by 3 to 6 Skeletons or Zombies. Found: Graveyards, hidden labs. Loot: B rank Shade focus.

Rank A Person Medium None Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 18 M/T 7 Saint's Cut (melee): Slashing damage; three attacks a turn. Counter: When its defense beats an attack, it strikes back with the same roll ( Chapter 12 ). Trait: A Saint rank master of a Combat Style. The Sword God's schools produce a handful a generation. Found: Sword dojos, the Asura capital. Loot: A rank sword.

The ten domains of the Demon Continent are each ruled by an Immortal Demon King, and all of them honor Empress Kishirika ( Chapter 2 ). They are people, not monsters, and most are not looking for a fight. Most of them regenerate from almost anything: Undying Flesh is their inheritance ( Chapter 8 ). Defeating one rarely means killing it.

Rank C Immortal Demon King Small None Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 6 / 5 / 4 Mana 12 M/T 5 Magic Eyes: Her eyes see anything she chooses: lies, futures, distant places. She knows what every enemy in sight is about to do (+5 dice to defense rolls). Gift an Eye: Grants a Magic Eye ( Chapter 9 ) to someone who helped her. Trait: The Demon Empress is famously weak in a fight, famously hungry, and famously generous to whoever feeds her. She has died and reincarnated at least five times. Rank C is her fighting strength, not her importance. Found: Wherever she wandered off to this time. Loot: A Magic Eye, if she likes you.

Rank SS Immortal Demon King Large (2x2) Battle Aura Attack 20 Defense 20 Damage 12 Move 1 BDT 13 / LDT 26 / ADT 39 Health 14 / 13 / 12 Mana 30 M/T 12 Six Arms: Six attacks a turn, kinetic damage. He laughs through all of them. Undying Flesh: Neutralizes all Bashing and Lethal damage each Upkeep, and regrows anything lost by the next scene. Only sealing him stops him. Fighting God: Wearing his legendary armor, his Attack pool rises by 5 and he casts Omega Burst (Battle Aura Rank 7) at will. Trait: Six-armed, loud, and delighted by a good fight or a good party. He has little magical aptitude and needs none. He is the husband of Kishirika and one of the few beings the Slime King treats as a peer. Found: Biegoya, in the far northeast, or wherever the wine is. Loot: His respect.

Rank SS Immortal Demon King Medium Battle Aura Attack 20 Defense 20 Damage 12 Move 1 BDT 12 / LDT 24 / ADT 36 Health 12 / 11 / 10 Mana 30 M/T 12 Demon Sword (melee): Slashing damage; four attacks a turn. Undying Flesh: As Badigadi. Conscription: Anyone she defeats becomes her disciple, whether they like it or not. Trait: Badigadi's sister: enormously strong, very loud, and not interested in nuance. She kidnaps foreign royalty and challenges every strong warrior she hears of. Her black-armored Imperial Guard follow her everywhere. Found: Gaslow, a dark bog in the east, under the shadow of a dark dragon. Loot: Disciple papers.

Rank B Person (Immortal Mix) Medium Battle Aura Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 7 / 6 / 5 Mana 15 M/T 6 Black Blade (melee): Slashing damage; two attacks a turn. Formation: Each guard adjacent to another adds 1 to its BDT. Trait: Black-armored disciples, nearly all of them former challengers who lost. Found: Gaslow, or wherever Atofe goes. Loot: B rank black armor.

Rank SS Immortal Demon King Large (2x2) Fire, Water, Air, Earth, Nature Attack 20 Defense 20 Damage 12 Move 1 BDT 13 / LDT 26 / ADT 39 Health 14 / 13 / 12 Mana 30 M/T 12 Five Elements: Casts Primordial Storm (Fire + Water + Air + Earth + Nature), or any spell of the five elemental schools. Strongest Fortress: In his fortress, every ally adds 2 to BDT and he sees every corridor. Undying Flesh: As Badigadi. Trait: The Five Elements Demon King, a tactician of the God Wars, father of Badigadi and Atoferatofe, and the one who brought Kishirika to Terrana. He built the strongest fortress on the Demon Continent and rules from its heart. Found: The heart of the Demon Continent. Loot: Strategy, if he deigns to share it.

Rank SS Immortal Demon King Small Earth, Nature Attack 20 Defense 20 Damage 12 Move 1 BDT 12 / LDT 24 / ADT 36 Health 12 / 11 / 10 Mana 30 M/T 12 Redesign: Changes the terrain of up to 10 zones each turn: walls, pits, rivers, stairs. Continental Shift: Casts the Earth Rank 7 spell. Creative Director: Inside the Grand Dungeon, she can teleport anyone on any floor to any other floor. Trait: A fairy-type Immortal Demon King who co-owns the Grand Dungeon with the Slime King and redesigns its floors on a whim. Fighting her in her dungeon is a very bad idea. Found: The Grand Dungeon. Loot: A new floor named after you, if she is amused.

Rank S Immortal Demon King Huge (3x3) Water, Shade Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 11 / LDT 22 / ADT 33 Health 13 / 12 / 11 Mana 21 M/T 8 Ink Tentacles: Four attacks a turn; kinetic damage, and every hit records the target's memories in ink. Library: Knows everything ever written. Adds 5 dice to any Intelligence roll. Trait: A monstrous black slime-octopus who rules the Library Labyrinth and records every piece of written lore in the world. Found: The Library Labyrinth, in the north. Loot: A book you were looking for.

Rank S Immortal Demon King Large (2x2) Earth, Fire Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 10 / LDT 20 / ADT 30 Health 11 / 10 / 9 Mana 21 M/T 8 King's Cleaver (melee): Slashing damage; three attacks a turn. Royal Feast: Every orc in sight neutralizes 1 Bashing and adds 1 die to attacks this turn. Trait: The pig-like King of the Orcs, ruler of the northwest. Judges a guest by their appetite. Found: The northwestern domain. Loot: A seat at his table.

Rank A Immortal Demon King Small Water, Shade Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 8 / 7 / 6 Mana 18 M/T 7 Possession: A creature that ingests Vita resists with Wisdom + Composure each turn; on a failure Vita controls its body and floods its mind with visions. Split: Can exist in many drops at once. Trait: A parasitic blue slime-demon. Its rank is low because it rarely fights with its own body; the body it is wearing decides how dangerous it is. Found: The western domain, or inside anyone. Loot: Nothing you want to keep.

Rank S Immortal Demon King Huge (3x3) Earth Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 11 / LDT 22 / ADT 33 Health 13 / 12 / 11 Mana 21 M/T 8 Stone Fortress: Casts the Earth Rank 6 spell. Petrify: Casts Petrify (Earth + Nature + Bright + Shade). Stone Body: Takes half damage from everything but Air and Nature attacks. Trait: The ruler of the southwest, as patient as the mountains. Found: The southwestern domain. Loot: Stone that never breaks.

Rank S Immortal Demon King Medium Bright Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 21 M/T 8 Final Light: Casts the Bright Rank 7 spell. Radiance: Undead and Void creatures within 3 zones take radiant damage each Upkeep. Trait: Ruler of the south, whose domain is never truly dark. Found: The southern domain. Loot: Light that keeps voidlings away.

Rank S Immortal Demon King Medium Water, Bright, Shade Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 21 M/T 8 Enchant: Every enemy in sight resists with Wisdom + Composure or fights for her this turn. Mirror Mist: Casts Mirror Mist (Water + Air + Bright + Shade). Trait: Ruler of the southeastern coast, whose court is full of people who do not remember arriving. Found: The southeastern coast. Loot: An invitation you should refuse.

Rank S Immortal Demon King Medium Shade Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 9 / 8 / 7 Mana 21 M/T 8 Black Rain: Casts Black Pulse (Shade Rank 6) as a rain of black liquid across 3x3 zones. Corrode: Anything it touches loses 1 Rating or 1 Armor. Trait: A floating orb leaking black liquid, ruling the continent's southern end. Found: The southern end of the Demon Continent. Loot: Corroded relics.

Every boss below is a dungeon employee ( Chapter 4 ): they fight hard and fight fair, and when they fall they respawn in their quarters. All use the Boss template: double health, two attacks a turn, and immunity to one condition.

Rank D Gremlinesque (Goblin) Medium None Boss Attack 8 Defense 8 Damage 5 Move 1 BDT 5 / LDT 10 / ADT 15 Health 10 / 8 / 6 Mana 9 M/T 4 Cleaver (melee): Slashing damage. Warband: Arrives with 6 Goblins; each turn Gruk shouts, they add 1 die to attacks. Trait: Thirty years on the job. Respects a fair fight. Found: Floor 4. Loot: D rank cleaver, a handshake.

Rank C Bestial Demonfolk (Orc) Medium Earth Boss Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 6 / LDT 12 / ADT 18 Health 12 / 10 / 8 Mana 12 M/T 5 Whip (melee, Reach): Slashing damage. Command Beast: Its Chimera (see Beasts) acts twice this turn. Trait: Fights beside a multi-headed Chimera in the Ironwood Colosseum while the stands bet on the outcome. Found: Floor 10. Loot: C rank whip, betting slips.

Rank C Brute (Minotaur) Large (2x2) Earth Boss Attack 10 Defense 10 Damage 6 Move 1 BDT 7 / LDT 14 / ADT 21 Health 16 / 14 / 12 Mana 12 M/T 5 Labrys (melee): Slashing damage. Hunter's Ear: Always knows where every enemy on the floor is. Trait: Waits at the Labyrinth's final gate. Found: Floor 14. Loot: C rank axe, a map that is always wrong.

Rank B Construct Huge (3x3) Earth, Fire Boss Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 22 / 20 / 18 Mana 15 M/T 6 Gear Crush (melee): Kinetic damage. Shift the Floor: Changes the speed of the floor's machinery: platforms move 1 zone and steam pipes burst (burning damage) each turn. Trait: The Shattered Clockwork, built by the Makers Guild long ago. Found: Floor 20. Loot: B rank clockwork core.

Rank B Beast (Thunderbird) Large (2x2) Air, Fire Boss Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 4 (flying) BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 18 / 16 / 14 Mana 15 M/T 6 Lightning Dive: Moves 4 zones and attacks; electric damage, and the target is knocked off any branch. Thunderstorm: Casts Thunderstorm (Fire + Water + Air + Nature). Trait: Rules the Canopy Wilds. Found: Floor 24. Loot: Storm feathers.

Rank B Fishfolk Champion Large (2x2) Water Boss Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 18 / 16 / 14 Mana 15 M/T 6 Sweeping Trident (melee, Reach): Piercing damage to everyone in adjacent zones. Current: Every enemy is pushed 1 zone each Upkeep. Trait: A Seafolk champion under contract with the Navigators Guild. Found: Floor 30. Loot: B rank trident.

Rank B Construct Huge (3x3) Earth, Fire Boss Attack 12 Defense 12 Damage 7 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 22 / 20 / 18 Mana 15 M/T 6 Ram: Moves 2 zones in a line and attacks; kinetic damage. Front Plate: Its BDT doubles against attacks from the front. Trait: A walking furnace built to clear cave-ins. Found: Floor 34. Loot: Furnace core.

Rank A Devil Medium Water, Air, Bright, Shade Boss Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 16 / 14 / 12 Mana 18 M/T 7 Mirror Copies: Creates a solid copy of each party member with their stats and abilities. Mirror Mist: Casts Mirror Mist (Water + Air + Bright + Shade). Trait: A high-tier devil illusionist from Nite City. Found: Floor 40. Loot: A rank mirror shard.

Rank A Aquatic (Siren) Medium Water, Air Boss Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 8 / LDT 16 / ADT 24 Health 16 / 14 / 12 Mana 18 M/T 7 Matron's Song: Every enemy resists with Composure + Insight or moves 2 zones toward the rising water. Tempest: Casts Tempest (Water + Air). Trait: The eldest of the ruins' sirens. Found: Floor 44. Loot: Siren pearl (A rank Water focus).

Rank A Dragon Huge (3x3) Fire, Earth Boss Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 10 / LDT 20 / ADT 30 Health 24 / 22 / 20 Mana 18 M/T 7 Magma Breath: Casts Lava (Fire + Earth + Nature). Melt the Arena: Each turn, one zone of the platform melts away. Trait: A wild fire drake fused with experimental company machinery. Found: Floor 50. Loot: A rank scale.

Rank A Construct Large (2x2) Bright, Shade Boss Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 20 / 18 / 16 Mana 18 M/T 7 Rune Blast: Casts Disruption (Bright + Shade). Riddles: Asks three questions before the fight; each answered well costs it a Boss template benefit. Trait: An ancient guardian covered in shifting runes. Found: Floor 54. Loot: Rune plate.

Rank A Undead Large (2x2) Shade Boss Attack 14 Defense 14 Damage 8 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 20 / 18 / 16 Mana 18 M/T 7 Wall Walk: Steps through walls to cut off retreat. Deadly Wail: Everyone makes a Sanity roll and resists with Fortitude + Endurance or loses their next action. Trait: An ancient knight representing the noble houses of the Shaded Isles. Found: Floor 60. Loot: A rank black armor.

Rank S Undead Medium Shade, Fire Boss Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 9 / LDT 18 / ADT 27 Health 18 / 16 / 14 Mana 21 M/T 8 Last Train: The ghost train charges through a line of zones; kinetic damage to everyone in it. Ticket, Please: Anyone without a valid ticket suffers -2 dice on all rolls. Trait: Insists every passenger present a valid ticket. Bring one. Found: Floor 64. Loot: A golden ticket.

Rank S Construct Large (2x2) Varies Boss Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 10 / LDT 20 / ADT 30 Health 22 / 20 / 18 Mana 21 M/T 8 Absorb: Any single-school spell that hits it is absorbed and adds 2 dice to its next attack. Circuit Lightning: Casts Thunderstorm (Fire + Water + Air + Nature). Trait: An advanced defense construct from the Mages Guild. Physical attacks and combination spells are the way through. Found: Floor 70. Loot: S rank construct heart.

Rank S Beast (Basilisk) Large (2x2) Earth, Shade Boss Attack 16 Defense 16 Damage 9 Move 1 BDT 10 / LDT 20 / ADT 30 Health 22 / 20 / 18 Mana 21 M/T 8 Crystal Gaze: As a Basilisk's gaze, but flesh turns to crystal. Every rule in this book works in any age. The rest of the book describes modern Terrana, about 150 years after the Slime King's arrival, but the same dice, the same Combat Styles, and the same magic can run a game in a dark age of swords and war, in the ruins of a fallen future, or among the stars. This chapter describes three alternate eras. Each one lists what changes from the modern game: the technology, the gear and prices, which Backgrounds and guilds exist, and the factions that matter. Anything not mentioned works exactly as it does in the rest of the book. Choosing an Era: The Storyteller picks the era before character creation, since it changes what players can buy and which Backgrounds make sense. Players should know the era before choosing a Trope or a Past Life Occupation.

Era When Technology Feel Inspirations The Distant Past During or just after the Great Hyuman-Demon War Swords, bows, and early magic; no implements to speak of Classic dark-age fantasy Berserk, Vinland Saga, Goblin Slayer Modern Terrana About 150 years after the Slime King (the rest of this book) Crystal engines, the CCN, guns, everyday implements Isekai adventure with modern comforts Mushoku Tensei, DanMachi A Fallen Future Some time after modern Terrana; how long is up to the Storyteller Today's technology as broken, half-understood relics Post-apocalyptic survival Fallout, Mad Max, Nausicaä The Space Era Hundreds to a thousand years after modern Terrana Starships, energy weapons, replicators Space opera among many worlds Cowboy Bebop, Tenchi Muyo, Star Trek, Star Wars, Dune, Sailor Moon

Long before Monsera, before the Slime King, before guilds ran governments and crystals ran kitchens, the world was at war. A game in the distant past is set during or just after the Great Hyuman-Demon War, when Hyumans and the peoples of the Demon Continent fought across the known world. It is a dark age: kingdoms rise and burn, roads are dangerous, magic is rare and feared, and a sword is worth more than a title.

Technology: No crystal engines, no CCN, no guns, and almost no implements. Light comes from fire, travel is on foot, by horse, or by sail, and news moves as fast as a rider. Combat Styles: Sundown and Iron Rain do not exist. Every other Style does, though under other names and taught by masters rather than schools. Magic: The seven schools work as written, but formal study is rare. Most casters learn from a single master, and circle magic is closely guarded. Expect Storytellers to limit which combination spells anyone has discovered. Backgrounds: Hacker and Subscribers do not exist. Guild Standing does not exist either; there are no cabinet guilds yet. Use Allies, Mentor, Nobility, Followers, and Street Cred instead. Monsera and Its Institutions: Monsera, the Hero Rangers Corps, Monsera University, and the Grand Dungeon do not exist. The Grand Dungeon has not been built yet; the Earth God made it much later. Gear and Prices: Use the weapons and armor in Chapter 14 except firearms, crystal-powered plate, and anything that runs on mana crystals. Coins vary from kingdom to kingdom, but the values in Chapter 14 still work as a guide. Healing potions are rare and cost at least twice as much. Heritages: Every heritage exists, but Hyumans and demons are at war, so a character's heritage decides where they are welcome. Storytellers may rule some heritages unavailable or hidden.

Behind the Lines: A small band is sent across the front to bring back a captured mage before the demon armies learn what she knows. The Last Village: The war has moved on, but the village is starving and a monster has learned that no soldiers are coming. Oathbreakers: Deserters from both sides form a company that sells its swords to whoever pays, until one job asks too much.

Something ended the modern world. The CCN went dark, the crystal engines stopped, and the cities emptied. Generations later, people live among the ruins of a civilization they barely understand, and today's ordinary technology has become a collection of ancient relics. What caused the fall is left open. Each Storyteller decides, and the players may never learn the whole truth. Some possibilities: A Great Breach: The Rift tore wide open and the Void poured through. The Seeming Spills Over: The nightmare half of the Void World broke its balance and seeped into Terrana. A New God War: Something awoke that the world was not ready to fight. The Mana Fails: Ambient mana thinned, and everything built on it collapsed at once.

Relics: Modern items (guns, CCN crystals, crystal engines, implements) are relics. A working relic counts as an artifact. A broken one needs a Crafts or Artifacts roll and parts to repair, and the Storyteller decides what still works. Ammunition and Crystals: Bullets and charged mana crystals are scarce. Track ammunition carefully, and treat mana crystals as the most valuable currency there is. Money: Coins are worth what someone will trade for them. Barter is common: food, water, ammunition, medicine, and crystals are the real currency. Resources above 3 is rare and usually means control of a settlement or a working relic. Guilds and Factions: The cabinet guilds are gone. Replace Guild Standing with standing in a settlement or faction, using the same 1 to 7 scale. The World: Ruined cities, Void-scarred wastes, mutated beasts, and fortified settlements. Old dungeons may be the safest places left, or the most dangerous. Magic: Magic works as written and may be the only reliable power left. Whether mages are honored or hunted depends on what caused the fall.

The Signal: An old CCN tower has started broadcasting again, and every faction in the wastes wants to reach it first. Water Rights: A settlement holds the only working water purifier for a hundred miles, and someone is trying to steal it. Into the Old City: The ruins of Monsera hold relics no one has touched in a century, and the things that live there now.

A researcher at Monsera University discovers that the energy signal of the Rift matches energy coming from far out in the sky. The Hero Rangers Corps forms a Sky Division to follow it, travel to other worlds, and connect their peoples. Games in the space era take place hundreds to a thousand years after that discovery. By then many planets and species have been met. Most are friendly to the HRC; some are not. Space travel has become a hot commodity for anyone seeking adventure, and ships, while still pricey, are common. Terrana itself remains fully playable: Monsera is the HRC's home world and the heart of an interstellar CCN. The heavens above Terrana, as charted by the HRC Sky Division. Every world in this chapter lies inside Terrana's bubble, between the sky and its outer wall.

Air: Space above Terrana is not a vacuum. It is thin, cold, and windy, but it can be breathed, and a person can stand on an open deck among the stars without a helmet. Gravity: Gravity always pulls toward Terrana, as though it were the center of everything, but the pull weakens the farther you go. Out among the worlds you are drawn to whatever large thing is closest: your ship, a station, or the nearest planet. Speed and Wind: Most ships are airtight, because at high speed the wind would tear the air and anything loose right out of them. At a normal pace an open deck is safe. Sailing Ships: Old-style wooden warships still sail between the worlds, driven by great Air Magic circles fixed to their masts and hulls. Space pirates are very real.

The Hero Rangers Corps Sky Division: The HRC's exploration fleet, much like a starfleet of explorers and diplomats. Its starships chart new worlds, keep the peace, and fight the Kaiju and voidlings that still come out of the dark. HRC ranks run 1 to 7 as on Terrana, and Guild Standing in the HRC is your rank. The Mercenaries Guild: What the Adventurers Guild is on Terrana, the Mercenaries Guild is in space. Its members are freelance crews who pilot their own ships and take whatever work pays: escort runs, salvage, bounties, and jobs nobody asks questions about. Its great hall is on Kordrane. The Free Reaches: Independent worlds and stations that answer to no crown. Kordrane, a rust-red mercenary port ringed by orbital stations, is its busiest world. Vessaril: A green garden world and the HRC's first ally. Vessaril is peaceful, beautiful, and fiercely protective of its forests. The Silver Court of Lunaria: A kingdom on Terrana's own Moon, hidden from the surface for most of history. Its court is elegant and ceremonial, its royal line is guarded by sworn protectors with their own names and colors, and its people draw on the light of the Moon itself. The Silver Court sees itself as the Moon's ancient guardian and treats the HRC as a younger but welcome ally. The Aurelion Dominion: A great space monarchy ruled from the ringed throne world of Aurelion. Like the other astral kingdoms, it spans several planets, each held by a noble house sworn to the throne: desert worlds rich in rare crystals, ocean worlds, and fortress moons. Its houses scheme against each other constantly, and the Dominion's favor is worth more than gold. The Varkesh Throne: A rival crown openly hostile to the HRC, ruling a dim cluster of worlds near the Sun's far side. The Varkesh see Terrana's expansion into the sky as an invasion, and their fleets test the HRC's borders often. Nyxhollow and the Outer Dark: Nyxhollow is a dark world full of the voidlings that sometimes break into Terrana, and the farthest the HRC has ever reached. Its energy resembles the Rift's, but the signal leads further still, into the Outer Dark, where no ship has gone and come back.

Bounty on Kordrane: A Mercenaries Guild crew takes a simple escort job and discovers their passenger is an heir the whole Aurelion Dominion is hunting. First Contact: An HRC starship answers a distress call from a world no chart shows, and the people there have been waiting for them. The Moon Princess: The Silver Court's heir vanishes during a state visit to Monsera, and the party is all that stands between the HRC and an interplanetary incident.

Ships use the vehicle rules from Chapter 14 . A ship's Rating comes from its rank like any other item and adds to the rolls made to fly and fight with it. Each size class needs a minimum crew to fly at all; a ship short on crew can still move, but it cannot use the stations that have no one in them.

Pilot: Flies the ship. Pilot rolls for maneuvers, chases, and dodging fire. Gunner: Fires the ship's weapons, using Perception + Ranged + Iron Rain. Engineer: Keeps the ship running and repairs damage. Crafts or Implements rolls. Sensors: Scans, tracks, and spots threats. Awareness rolls. Captain: Commands and coordinates. Once per turn the captain can give one crew member +2 dice with a Presence or Diplomacy roll. Ship Damage: A ship takes hits exactly like a character. Its BDT is its Armor + its Size, so small arms rarely scratch a big ship. Its Hull Track has the same three columns as a character's health track: a hit that meets the ship's BDT marks a Bashing box (dents and scrapes), its LDT a Lethal box (hull breaches), and its ADT an Aggravated box (critical systems). A fighter's track matches a person's (7 Bashing, 5 Lethal, 3 Aggravated), and each size above 1 adds 2 boxes to every column. A ship that fills its Hull Track is disabled, not destroyed, unless the Storyteller says otherwise.

Hull Track boxes are Bashing / Lethal / Aggravated. Max Capacity is everyone the ship can carry, crew and passengers. Everything in Chapter 14 still exists, though most of it is old-fashioned. Energy weapons use the same Styles as the weapons they replace, and their Rating comes from their rank like any other weapon. Energy Weapons Are Attuned: Blasters and energy blades are implements, but unlike other implements they only work for someone attuned to them. Attuning holds part of your Max Mana Per Turn equal to the weapon's Rating for as long as you stay attuned. An unattuned blaster or energy blade cannot be used at all.

Many species live among the stars. A player can design their own with the Storyteller, using the Spacefaring Species template, or choose one of the optional species below. Every species follows the same pattern as the heritages in Chapter 8 : a lifespan, an Innate Attribute, an Innate Flaw, an Attribute Flaw, a few Heritage Merit options, and a Heritage magic.

Lifespan: Choose one tier with the Storyteller: 100, 200, 400, or 1000 years. Innate Attribute: Choose one attribute that fits the species with the Storyteller. Innate Flaw: Choose one drawback with the Storyteller, about as strong as the flaws in Chapter 8 . Attribute Flaw: Choose one attribute group that can never be your Affinity column. Heritage Merits: Pick broad options the way Demon does: a free specialty, a natural sense, a natural weapon, or a tolerance to one environment. Heritage Magic: Design it with the Storyteller following the Tribal Magic guidelines in the Demon heritage ( Chapter 8 ): seven ranks, two choices per rank, mana equal to rank.

Who They Are: The golden-skinned, tall, and long-lived people of the Aurelion Dominion, raised in a culture of noble houses and endless politics. Lifespan: 400 years. Innate Attribute: Composure. Innate Flaw: Proud Blood: -1 die on rolls to deceive or flatter anyone they consider beneath their house. Attribute Flaw: Physical. Heritage Merit (choose 1): Courtly Bearing: Grants a free specialty in Etiquette called Courtly Bearing, providing a bonus die in noble courts, formal events, and any room where rank matters. Golden Presence: Grants a free specialty in Presence called Golden Presence, providing a bonus die to command attention or be obeyed by anyone who sees you as nobility. Heritage Magic: Sovereign Light. Radiance and command: auras of authority, light, and influence over crowds.

Aurelian houses rule by bearing as much as by law. Sovereign Light is the radiance of a noble line: golden light that dazzles and burns, and a voice that others find very hard to refuse. Primary: Composure + Presence + Sovereign Light Secondary: Charisma + Diplomacy + Sovereign Light Extra mana: Attack only. 1 die per mana, up to your Sovereign Light dots or Max Mana Per Turn, whichever comes first.

Heritage Merit (choose 1): Moonsight: Grants a free specialty in Awareness called Moonsight, providing a bonus die on sight rolls by moonlight or starlight, and lets you see by them as well as by day. Silver Grace: Grants a free specialty in Performance called Silver Grace, providing a bonus die on dance, ceremony, and any performance meant to awe. Heritage Magic: Moonweave. Moonlight: healing light, protective wards, illusions, and transformation.

The Silver Court learned long ago that moonlight is gentle and deceptive at once. Moonweave heals with cool silver light, guards with crescent wards, and fills the dark with shapes that are not really there. Who They Are: Plant-like people of the garden world Vessaril, with bark-patterned skin and leaves for hair. Patient, gentle, and terrifying when their forests are threatened. Lifespan: 400 years. Innate Attribute: Wisdom. Innate Flaw: Sun-Fed: without sunlight or strong light for a full day, they cannot recover Willpower checks or heal Bashing damage until they get it. Attribute Flaw: Social. Every Vessari is part of a forest, even light-years from home. Rootsong speaks with growing things, roots the singer in place, and lets living wood close wounds and rise as walls and guardians.
