Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Utility Use: Outside combat Range: Plants in your zone and adjacent zones Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Rootsong Defense: None Effect: The plants answer one simple question per success about what has passed by them.

Mana Cost: 1, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Attuned Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, your skin hardens into bark, adding 1 to your BDT. This counts as the magic part of your BDT.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: One target up to 2 zones away Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Rootsong Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: A whip of thorned vine. Damage is piercing. Add your Heritage dots to the damage roll.

Mana Cost: 2, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Attuned Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, you cannot be moved, pushed, or knocked Prone, but you cannot move either.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Debuff Use: Combat Range: One target in sight Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Rootsong Defense: Strength + Athletics Effect: The target resists with Strength + Athletics. If you beat them, they gain the Rooted condition until they beat your casting successes with Strength + Athletics on their turn.

Mana Cost: 3 Speed: Instant Type: Healing Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self or one target in an adjacent zone Dice Pool: Composure + Endurance + Rootsong Defense: None Effect: The target gains a PHP equal to your casting successes and the Bleeding condition ends. Healing tier: Basic.

Mana Cost: 4, upkeep 3 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Persistent Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Up to 2 connected empty zones in sight Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While maintained, a wall of living wood fills the zones. It blocks movement and gives full cover. An attack breaks one zone of it only if the attacker rolls more successes than you did when casting.

Mana Cost: 4, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Healing, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, during each Upkeep Phase you neutralize 1 Bashing damage.

Mana Cost: 5, upkeep 4 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Attack, Persistent Use: Combat Range: Up to 3 connected zones in sight Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Rootsong Defense: Dexterity + Acrobatics Effect: While maintained, thorns fill the zones and make them Difficult Terrain. During each Upkeep Phase, roll once against every enemy in them; each defends separately. Damage is piercing.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant Type: Healing Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Every ally in your zone and adjacent zones Dice Pool: Composure + Endurance + Rootsong Defense: None Effect: Each ally in range gains a PHP equal to half your casting successes, rounded up. Healing tier: Advanced.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Instant Type: Conjuration Use: Combat Range: An empty adjacent zone Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Rootsong Defense: None Effect: An awakened tree rises. It cannot act on the turn it is summoned. On later turns you can command it to attack a target in an adjacent zone using your Primary dice pool (damage is kinetic) or to hold its zone. It has your BDT and falls when a hit meets its LDT.

Mana Cost: 6, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Attuned Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, add your Heritage dots to your BDT against physical attacks. This counts as the magic part of your BDT.

Mana Cost: 7, upkeep 6 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Healing, Persistent Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Your zone and every zone within 2 Dice Pool: Composure + Endurance + Rootsong Defense: None Effect: A great tree grows where you stand. While maintained, during each Upkeep Phase every ally in range gains a PHP equal to your Heritage dots. Healing tier: Advanced.

Mana Cost: 7 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: Every enemy within 3 zones Dice Pool: Wisdom + Survival + Rootsong Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: Roots and thorns erupt from every surface. Roll once; each target defends separately. Damage is piercing. Every enemy you hit gains the Rooted condition until the end of their next turn.

Who They Are: Short, dense, immensely strong people from heavy-gravity worlds in the Free Reaches. Many crew mercenary ships as loaders and enforcers. Lifespan: 200 years. Innate Attribute: Strength. Innate Flaw: Heavy Frame: cannot swim, and -1 die on Acrobatics rolls. Attribute Flaw: Mental. Heritage Merit (choose 1): Dense Frame: Grants a free specialty in Endurance called Dense Frame, providing a bonus die to resist being knocked back, knocked Prone, or crushed. Gravity-Born: Grants a free specialty in Athletics called Gravity-Born, providing a bonus die to lift, carry, and throw, and to move in strong or shifting gravity. Heritage Magic: Weight of Worlds. Gravity: growing heavier, anchoring, pulling, and crushing.

Gravkin grow up where the ground pulls hard, and they carry that pull with them. Weight of Worlds makes the caster heavier or lighter at will, drags enemies down, and turns a dropped fist into a falling star. Primary: Strength + Athletics + Weight of Worlds Secondary: Fortitude + Endurance + Weight of Worlds Extra mana: Damage only. 1 die per mana, up to your Weight of Worlds dots or Max Mana Per Turn, whichever comes first.

Mana Cost: 1, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, nothing can push, pull, or knock you Prone unless it beats your Strength + Athletics.

Mana Cost: 1 Speed: Instant Type: Utility Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self or one object you touch Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: Until the end of the scene, the target weighs a tenth as much and halves any falling damage it takes.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: Melee Dice Pool: Strength + Athletics + Weight of Worlds Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: Your fist lands with the weight of a boulder. Damage is kinetic. Add your Heritage dots to the damage roll, and on a hit push the target one zone.

Mana Cost: 2 Speed: Instant Type: Utility Use: Combat and outside combat Range: One target or object in sight Dice Pool: Strength + Athletics + Weight of Worlds Defense: Strength + Athletics Effect: Pull the target one zone toward you. A creature resists with Strength + Athletics.

Mana Cost: 3, upkeep 2 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Debuff, Persistent Use: Combat Range: One zone in sight and every zone adjacent to it Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While maintained, the area is Difficult Terrain, and flying creatures in it must land.

Mana Cost: 3, lasts half the mana spent in turns, rounded up; pay 2 in an Upkeep Phase to freeze the countdown Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Debuff, Countdown Use: Combat Range: One target in sight Dice Pool: Strength + Athletics + Weight of Worlds Defense: Strength + Athletics Effect: If you beat the target, their weight doubles: -2 dice on physical rolls and 1 less zone of movement, until the countdown runs out or they beat your casting successes with Strength + Athletics on their turn.

Mana Cost: 4 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: All adjacent zones Dice Pool: Strength + Athletics + Weight of Worlds Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: Roll once; each target defends separately. Damage is kinetic. Every enemy you hit is knocked Prone.

Mana Cost: 4, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Movement, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, you can leap up to 3 zones as your movement and walk on walls and ceilings.

Mana Cost: 5 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: One target in sight Dice Pool: Strength + Athletics + Weight of Worlds Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: Hurl yourself into the air and come down on the target, landing in an empty zone next to them. Damage is kinetic. Add your Heritage dots to the damage roll.

Mana Cost: 5, upkeep 4 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Defense, Persistent Use: Combat Range: Self Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While maintained, loose debris circles you. Ranged attacks against you suffer -2 dice, as if you had half cover.

Mana Cost: 6 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: One zone in sight and every zone adjacent to it Dice Pool: Strength + Athletics + Weight of Worlds Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: Every enemy in the area is pulled one zone toward the center. Then roll once; each target defends separately. Damage is crushing.

Mana Cost: 6, upkeep 5 each Upkeep Phase Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Debuff, Persistent Use: Combat Range: Every enemy in sight Dice Pool: Strength + Athletics + Weight of Worlds Defense: Strength + Athletics Effect: Roll once; each enemy resists separately. While maintained, every enemy you beat moves at half movement, rounded down, and cannot fly.

Mana Cost: 7 Speed: Instant Type: Attack Use: Combat Range: One target in sight Dice Pool: Strength + Athletics + Weight of Worlds Defense: Target's choice of defense Effect: Gravity folds in on the target. Damage is crushing. Add your Heritage dots to the damage roll. On a hit the target is knocked Prone and gains the Rooted condition until the end of their next turn.

Mana Cost: 7, attuned (stays committed) Speed: Instant, Extended Type: Utility, Attuned Use: Combat and outside combat Range: Self and up to your Heritage dots willing allies in sight Dice Pool: None Defense: None Effect: While attuned, you choose which way gravity pulls for yourself and the chosen allies. You can all walk on any surface and fall in any direction you choose.

Every term below is explained in full in the chapter named after it. This index is for quick lookup at the table: terms are grouped by topic and listed alphabetically within each group. Page numbers will be added once the whole book is compiled.

Bonus Die : An extra die added to a roll by a specialty, a Boon, a scale position, AP, Willpower, mana, or an ability. Called Shot ( Ch. 12 ) : Aiming at a specific limb, weapon, or vital spot costs -2 dice. Its effect only happens if the attack hits. Dice Pool : The number of d10s rolled for an action, usually an Attribute + an Ability, plus any Style or school dots and bonus dice. Excess Successes : Successes the attacker rolls beyond the defender's roll. They carry forward and are added to the damage roll. Penalty Die : A die removed from a roll by a Bane, a scale position, a wound penalty, or an enemy's technique. Penalties on enemies stay flat; they never scale with dots. Success : Any die showing 6 or higher is 1 success. A 10 counts as 2 successes. There are no critical failures.

Affinity, Standard, Aversion ( Ch. 6 ) : The three attribute columns. The number next to each is both its cap and its points to spend: 6, 5, and 4. They also set Combat Style or Magical Knowledge dots at creation: 7, 5, and 3. Attribute Flaw ( Ch. 8 ) : One attribute group a heritage can never take as its Affinity column. Hyumans and Vampires have none. Driving Factor ( Ch. 7 ) : What your character wants. Each one belongs to a scale and a side; you start with one for each of your two highs. Freebie Points ( Ch. 6 ) : 7 points to spend at the end of creation: Attribute 3, Ability 2, Combat Style or Magical Knowledge 4, Background 1, Mana 7 per dot. They cannot buy Merits, Flaws, Willpower, Fate, Sanity, or Heritage traits. Funds ( Ch. 14 ) : The money your character has on hand, tracked next to Resources on the sheet. Golden Rule ( Ch. 6 ) : Nothing on the sheet can be filled above 5 dots at character creation, not even with Freebie Points. Heritage ( Ch. 8 ) : Your character's people. Sets lifespan, an Innate Attribute, an Innate Flaw, an Attribute Flaw, Heritage Merits, and Heritage magic. Level ( Ch. 6 ) : The total of your dots in Attributes (including Mana), Abilities, Combat Styles, Magical Knowledges (including Heritage magic), and Merits, Flaws, and Backgrounds. Willpower, Fate, Sanity, and the scales do not count. Past Life Occupation ( Ch. 6 ) : What your character did before arriving in Terrana. Abilities tied to it are marked PL and cost new dot x2 XP. Primary (P) ( Ch. 6 ) : Every Combat Style and Magical Knowledge taken in creation Steps 10 and 11, plus the free Heritage magic dot, is marked P and costs new dot x5 XP. Role ( Ch. 6 ) : Your battlefield position: a line (Frontline, Midline, Backline) plus one word for how you fight, such as Backline Mage. Scale Positions ( Ch. 7 ) : Each of the seven Virtue and Vice scales has five positions: High Virtue (2), Low Virtue (1), Central (0), Low Vice (1), and High Vice (2). The number is how many dice it adds or removes. Secondary (S) ( Ch. 6 ) : Every Combat Style and Magical Knowledge gained after creation Steps 10 and 11 is marked S and costs new dot x6 XP. Specialty ( Ch. 6 ) : A condition written next to an ability that adds a bonus die when it applies. Up to 3 per ability; one is free for any ability at 4 or more dots at creation, the rest cost 5 XP. Trope ( Ch. 7 ) : Your character's personality archetype. Each gives a Boon (+1 die with one ability) and a Bane (-1 die with another).

Dots and Boxes ( Ch. 11 ) : Willpower, Fate, and Sanity each have 10 dots and a row of 10 boxes. Checks fill from the left, X's from the right, and nothing resets on rest. A full row of checks gains a dot; a full row of X's loses one. None can go below 1 or above 10. Fate ( Ch. 11 ) : Your karmic weight in the world and your power to bend its story. Never spent; built and lost through influence and Fate contests. Fate Contest ( Ch. 11 ) : Both sides roll their Fate as a dice pool; most successes wins, the defender wins ties. Opposing Fate can be pooled. Guild Standing ( Ch. 10 ) : Your rank in one guild, 1 to 7. The Storyteller sets the limit at creation, usually 3. In the HRC, it is your Corps rank. Mana (Attribute) ( Ch. 11 ) : Rated 1 to 10, the only trait with ten dots. Every character starts with 1. Freebies cost 7 per dot; XP costs new dot x7. Resources ( Ch. 10 ) : Wealth, income, and lifestyle. Every character starts with 1 free dot: a modest life in a one-bedroom apartment or dorm room. Sanity ( Ch. 11 ) : Your hold on reality and your dice pool for resisting the Void. Lost dots bring traumas, from a phobia at 4 to severe trauma at 2. At 1 and at 10 the Storyteller takes control of the character. Willpower ( Ch. 11 ) : Mental and emotional resilience and the health track for social combat. Spend 1 per turn, as no action, to add 3 dice before a roll or reroll up to 3 failed dice after it. Each spend marks an X.

Dots, ranks, and Ratings share one scale across the whole game. Dots Rank Combat Styles Magical Knowledges Item and Weapon Rating 1 F Elementary Core +1 2 E Intermediate Terrestrial +2 3 D Advanced Aerial +3 4 C Saint Lunar +4 5 B Royal Stellar +5 6 A Imperial Galactic +6 7 S Divine Cosmic +7

Action Points (AP) ( Ch. 6 ) : Hold up to 3 AP; use up to 6 in one turn. Regain 1 during Upkeep, or 2 if you took damage. Spend 1, 3, or 6 AP for +1, +2, or +3 dice, or for 1, 2, or 3 extra zones of movement. Shared AP ( Ch. 6 ) : Allies can give AP freely at no action cost, from any mix of allies, but no one uses more than 6 AP in a turn. Zone : One square on the battlefield. Only one creature or object can occupy a zone; nothing is ever "in your zone" except you. Movement : Dexterity 1 to 4: 1 zone per turn. Dexterity 5 to 6: 2 zones. Dexterity 7: 3 zones. Standing from Prone counts as moving 1 zone. Initiative ( Ch. 6 ) : Dexterity + Perception. Flight ( Ch. 8 ) : Anything that flies moves at double its normal movement. Winged flyers use the Athletics specialty Flight. Mechanical Flight ( Ch. 14 ) : Flight from machines, vehicles, and devices. It must use all of its movement every turn or begin to fall. Empowered Flight ( Ch. 13 ) : Battle Aura Rank 6 flight: 6 mana (or 3 Willpower) to take off, 5 mana upkeep at altitude, 3 to hover. Taking damage that meets your BDT forces a Dexterity + Athletics roll or you begin to fall. Counter ( Ch. 12 ) : When your defense roll beats an attack, a Counter strikes back using that same roll as your attack. Range ( Ch. 14 ) : Melee hits adjacent zones (one farther with Reach). Thrown: up to double your Strength in zones. Bows, guns, and ranged spells: anywhere in line of sight. Creature Ranks ( Ch. 15 ) : Creatures run from F to SSS; SS and SSS jump in power. Stats come from rank and size (Creature Stats by Rank). Cover ( Ch. 14 ) : Draw a line from your square to the target's. Through the front and back of the square it hides behind: full cover, no shot. Only a side and the back, or a corner: half cover, -2 dice. Armor Penetration ( Ch. 12 ) : Lowers the Armor part of a target's BDT for your hit only. Full Armor Penetration ignores all of it. Never lowers Fortitude or Resilience. Magic Penetration ( Ch. 12 ) : Lowers the magic part of a target's BDT the same way. Upkeep Phase : Start of your turn: recover mana and AP, pay upkeep for persistent effects, and resolve Burning, Bleeding, Poisoned, and similar triggers. Planning Phase : Declare movement, item use, attacks, and spells. The Storyteller declares enemy actions. Move or Use Item Phases : Before and after your action: move your zones, use a belt item, or both by spending AP. Action Phase : Roll your attack against the target's defense. If you win, your excess successes carry into the damage roll. Damage Phase : Roll your damage pool, add your excess successes, and compare the total to the target's thresholds. Ending Phase : Resolve end-of-turn triggers and conditions.

ADT (Aggravated Damage Threshold) ( Ch. 6 ) : BDT x3. Meeting it deals 1 Aggravated. Bashing, Lethal, Aggravated : The three tiers of damage, from bruises to deep wounds to severe trauma that can leave lasting marks. BDT (Bashing Damage Threshold) ( Ch. 6 ) : Fortitude + Armor, plus Resilience if you have that Merit, plus any magic. Meeting it deals 1 Bashing. Bright and Shade Damage ( Ch. 13 ) : Bright damages undead but not the living; Shade damages the living but not undead. Both can help or hinder either. Damage Pool ( Ch. 14 ) : A weapon's damage Attribute + its Rating. Damage Subtypes : Slashing, Piercing, Kinetic, Burning, Electric, Constricting, Crushing, and Falling describe how an attack hurts and may interact with armor or abilities as the Storyteller rules. An attack never names Bashing, Lethal, or Aggravated; comparing its damage to the target's thresholds decides that. Falling Damage : 1d10 per 10 feet (one vertical zone). The face values are the damage, not successes; below BDT means no damage. Healing Tiers ( Ch. 13 ) : Healing spells give a PHP. Basic: neutralize 1 Bashing or slake 1 Lethal. Advanced: neutralize 2 Bashing, neutralize 1 Lethal, or slake 1 Aggravated. Expert: neutralize 4 Bashing, 2 Lethal, or 1 Aggravated. Master regrows lost limbs, outside combat only. LDT (Lethal Damage Threshold) ( Ch. 6 ) : BDT x2. Meeting it deals 1 Lethal. PHP (Pool of Healing Points) ( Ch. 13 ) : Healing points equal to the cast successes. The target spends them on their own turn at no action cost. Most pools end at the end of the target's next turn. Slake and Neutralize ( Ch. 13 ) : To slake a damage box is to lower it one tier; to neutralize it is to remove it. Wound Penalties : The -1, -2, and -4 marked on the health track, applied to rolls as damage fills it. Penalties are cumulative across damage types.

Bleeding : Each Upkeep, roll Fortitude + Endurance (plus Resilience if you have it) against the effect's rating: success takes 1 Bashing, failure 1 Lethal. Lasts until healed or Cleansed. Applying pressure (no other actions) stops the next tick. Blinded : Cannot cast any spell or make an attack that targets a person or zone. Burning : Each Upkeep, roll Fortitude + Endurance (plus Resilience if you have it) against the effect's rating: success takes 1 Bashing, failure 1 Lethal. Ends with Water Magic, or by spending a full turn putting it out. Chilled : Penalty dice on Dexterity rolls. Ends with Fire Magic or Cleanse. Exhausted : No free move or free action; all movement and attacks cost AP. Lasts until an Upkeep Phase outside the affected zone. Grappled : No belt items or attacks. During Upkeep, roll Strength + Athletics to break free; on a failure, the Action Phase can be used to try again. Impairment : A lost or useless limb. An arm halves all dice pools (rounded up); a leg removes free movement, so all movement costs AP. Mana Bleed ( Ch. 13 ) : Losing mana during an Upkeep Phase from an ongoing effect, mostly Shade. Petrified : Works like Rooted and Grappled at once: no moving, attacking, casting, or items. During Upkeep, roll Strength + Athletics against the cast successes to break free. Poisoned : Each Upkeep, take the poison's damage value against your thresholds. Roll Fortitude + Endurance each turn to lower it. Ends at 0 or with Cleanse. Prone : Knocked down. Standing up counts as moving 1 zone. Rooted : Cannot move zones. Stunned ( Ch. 12 ) : Not a separate condition: a stun is written as losing AP on your next turn.

Incapacitation : Reached when all Aggravated boxes are full, or a hit lands in a column that is already full. The player chooses Fall Unconscious, Risk It, or Blaze of Glory. Fall Unconscious : The character drops until at least one Aggravated is removed or lowered to Lethal. Risk It : Keep fighting with all penalties. One more Aggravated and the character dies. Blaze of Glory : One final turn: every die in the pool counts as a 10 for both attack and damage, and the opponent defends normally. Then the character dies, and cannot be resurrected. Mana Countdown ( Ch. 13 ) : When a character dies without choosing to, the mana they held counts down 1 per day. At 0, an uncremated body rises as mindless undead. Resurrection ( Ch. 13 ) : The six-school combination spell (Fire, Water, Air, Nature, Bright, Shade at 6 dots) that can return someone who died without choosing to, before their mana countdown runs out. Dungeon Respawn ( Ch. 4 ) : In the Grand Dungeon a bracelet sends a fallen delver to their locker instead: all Lethal and Aggravated removed, every Bashing box marked.

Acting Against Your Scales ( Ch. 7 ) : Low positions can only cost Willpower; minor violations at a High position cost Willpower, severe ones cost Sanity. Critical Comeback ( Ch. 11 ) : A defender who rolls 5 or more successes over the attacker ends the exchange in their own favor. End of a Social Combat ( Ch. 11 ) : It ends when either side fills their Willpower row with X's, or when 5 or more damage lands in one retort. Social Combat ( Ch. 11 ) : The attacker rolls a Social Attribute + an Ability; the defender rolls Willpower + Composure. Each excess success deals 1 Willpower damage.

Attuned ( Ch. 13 ) : An effect or item that holds part of your M/T for as long as it is active. Ending it returns the mana during the next Upkeep Phase. Battle Aura ( Ch. 13 ) : The discipline of running mana through body and weapon. From Rank 4 its techniques can be paid with 1 to 4 Willpower, separate from the once-per-turn spend. Committed Mana ( Ch. 13 ) : Mana paid as upkeep for a persistent effect; it counts toward your M/T. Countdown ( Ch. 13 ) : A persistent effect lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying upkeep freezes the countdown for that turn. Default Ability ( Ch. 12 , 13) : The free ability that comes with every dot of a Combat Style, casting school, or Battle Aura. Elemental Advantage ( Ch. 13 ) : Strong advantage +2 dice, moderate +1: Fire beats Nature and Earth, Nature beats Earth and Air, Earth beats Air and Water, Air beats Water and Fire, Water beats Fire and Nature. Imbuing ( Ch. 13 ) : Carrying one casting school's energy on a physical attack, through Battle Aura from Rank 4 or through an Augmentation. Not combination magic. Mana Burn ( Ch. 11 ) : Spending past your M/T: 1 over deals 1 Bashing, 2 over 1 Lethal, 3 over 1 Aggravated, 4 over 2 Aggravated, then 1 more Aggravated per mana. Any Aggravated from it leaves a permanent mark. Mana Pool (MP) ( Ch. 11 ) : (Magic dots + Circle Magic dots) x Mana. Mana Recovery ( Ch. 11 ) : Each Upkeep: 1 mana at 1 to 3 Mana dots, 2 at 4 to 6, 3 at 7 to 8, 4 at 9, 5 at 10, plus 1 if you took damage. Outside combat, a few minutes of rest refills the pool. Mana Sickness ( Ch. 11 ) : Damage from mana density: Bashing in elevated areas, Lethal in extreme ones. Arrivals with no Mana take Bashing from the world itself. Max Mana Per Turn (M/T) ( Ch. 11 ) : Fortitude + Mana: the most mana you can safely spend in one turn. Upkeep costs count toward it. Prepared Spells ( Ch. 13 ) : You can have spells prepared equal to your Intelligence. Swap freely outside combat; the list is fixed during a fight. Running Dry ( Ch. 11 ) : Spending your pool down to 0 knocks you unconscious until you recover mana. Unchosen Option ( Ch. 12 , 13) : The option or spell you did not pick at a rank, bought later for Rank x2 XP. Upcast ( Ch. 13 ) : Extra mana beyond a spell's cost, declared before rolling, either to add dice or to augment the effect, never both. Upkeep ( Ch. 13 ) : The cost to keep a persistent effect going each Upkeep Phase: always the spell's mana cost minus 1.

AoE Shapes : Cone (1, then 3, then 5 zones forward; can hit allies), Line (every zone in one direction), and squares of 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5 zones. Attack : Deals damage to a target. Buff : Gives an ally a positive effect. CC (Crowd Control) : Restricts movement or takes away actions. Cleanse : Removes conditions from the living, or applies them to undead. Conjuration : Creates an entity that acts on its own turn after a command; it cannot act the turn it appears. Corrupt : Removes conditions from undead, or applies them to the living. Debuff : Puts penalty dice or reduced stats on an enemy. Drain : Removes mana directly from a target's pool. Healing : Gives a target a PHP. Persistent : Has a duration and can be kept going with upkeep. Reaction : A spell cast in response to something on another character's turn. Utility : A non-damage effect that changes the situation. Vitality Pool : Health for a conjured entity or effect. At 0, it is destroyed.

Circle Magic ( Ch. 13 ) : Ritual magic made outside combat: scrolls, divination, summoning, teleportation, contracts, bindings, wards, augmentation, spatial magic, and time magic. A finished circle can be used at any time. Combination Cap ( Ch. 13 ) : A combination works at the lowest dot rating among its schools. Combination Spell ( Ch. 13 ) : A spell woven from two to six schools. It needs dots in every school equal to its rank and costs schools x dots in mana (4, 9, 16, 25, or 36). Creation Magic ( Ch. 13 ) : The combination of all seven schools at 7 dots: the only magic that brings new autonomous life into the world. It can be the work of many casters, or of a town's belief, over time. Learning Combinations ( Ch. 13 ) : Take one free in place of a rank's standard spell when a new dot meets its prerequisites, or buy it for Rank x2 XP per school.

Arcane Enhancement ( Ch. 9 ) : A Merit that boosts a trait with a built-in enhancement and permanently lowers Max Mana Per Turn. Armor ( Ch. 14 ) : Only body armor and helmets add Armor. Light armor comes in ranks F to D (1 to 3), Medium D to B (3 to 5), Heavy B to S (5 to 7). Your Physical column limits what you can wear. Artifact ( Ch. 13 , 14) : An item that gained random magical abilities in a place of dense mana. Attuning holds M/T equal to its Rating. Augmentation ( Ch. 13 , 14) : A magical or mechanical enhancement built into the body or a weapon with an augment slot. Body augmentations hold M/T equal to their Rating. Belt Slots ( Ch. 14 ) : 3 items set before combat. The first used in a turn is free, the second costs 1 AP, the third 2 more. Slots 4 to 7 open only when an item or ability grants them. Implement ( Ch. 13 , 14) : A magic item made on purpose for one known effect. Costs mana each use; no attunement. Item Rating ( Ch. 14 ) : A rank from F to S (1 to 7). It adds to the rolls the item is made for. Shield ( Ch. 14 ) : Adds its own Armor bonus: +1 Light, +2 Medium, +3 Heavy. Weapon Rating ( Ch. 14 ) : Comes from rank alone: F +1 up to S +7. Added to the damage pool.
